<h3 id="indicesputindextemplate1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|Index or template name|
|cause|query|string|false|User defined reason for creating/updating the index template.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|create|query|boolean|false|If `true`, this request cannot replace or update existing index templates.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» index_patterns|body|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|false|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|» composed_of|body|[[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)]|false|An ordered list of component template names.<br>Component templates are merged in the order specified, meaning that the last component template specified has the highest precedence.|
|» template|body|[indices.put_index_template___IndexTemplateMapping](#schemaindices.put_index_template___indextemplatemapping)|false|none|
|» data_stream|body|[indices._common___IndexTemplateDataStreamConfiguration](#schemaindices._common___indextemplatedatastreamconfiguration)|false|The data stream configuration for an index template.|
|» priority|body|integer|false|Priority to determine index template precedence when a new data stream or index is created.<br>The index template with the highest priority is chosen.<br>If no priority is specified the template is treated as though it is of priority 0 (lowest priority).<br>This number is not automatically generated by OpenSearch.|
|» version|body|[_common___VersionNumber](#schema_common___versionnumber)|false|none|
|» _meta|body|[_common___Metadata](#schema_common___metadata)|false|The custom metadata attached to a resource.|

|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

## insights.top_queries.0

```bash

  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_insights/top_queries`

Retrieves the top queries based on the given metric type (latency, CPU, or memory).

<h3 id="insightstopqueries0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|query|[insights._common___MetricType](#schemainsights._common___metrictype)|true|Get top n queries by a specific metric.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

|---|---|
|type|cpu|
|type|latency|

## list.help.0

<a id="opIdlist.help.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_list
```

`GET /_list`

Returns help for the List APIs.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/list/index/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="listhelp0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="listhelp0-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## list.indices.0

<a id="opIdlist.indices.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_list/indices \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_list/indices`

Returns paginated information about indexes including number of primaries and replicas, document counts, disk size.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/list/list-indices/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="listindices0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|bytes|query|[_common___ByteUnit](#schema_common___byteunit)|false|The unit used to display byte values.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|The type of index that wildcard patterns can match.|
|format|query|string|false|A short version of the Accept header, such as `JSON`, `YAML`.|
|h|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of column names to display.|
|health|query|[_common___HealthStatus](#schema_common___healthstatus)|false|The health status used to limit returned indexes. By default, the response includes indexes of any health status.|
|help|query|boolean|false|Return help information.|
|include_unloaded_segments|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes information from segments that are not loaded into memory.|
|local|query|boolean|false|Return local information, do not retrieve the state from cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|next_token|query|null \| string|false|Token to retrieve next page of indexes.|
|pri|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response only includes information from primary shards.|
|s|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of column names or column aliases to sort by.|
|size|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of indexes to be displayed in a page.|
|sort|query|[_common___SortOrder](#schema_common___sortorder)|false|Defines order in which indexes will be displayed. Accepted values are `asc` and `desc`. If `desc`, most recently created indexes would be displayed first.|
|time|query|[_common___TimeUnit](#schema_common___timeunit)|false|The unit used to display time values.|
|v|query|boolean|false|Verbose mode. Display column headers.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

## list.indices.1

<a id="opIdlist.indices.1"></a>

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_list/indices/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_list/indices/{index}`

Returns paginated information about indexes including number of primaries and replicas, document counts, disk size.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/list/list-indices/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="listindices1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`). To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|bytes|query|[_common___ByteUnit](#schema_common___byteunit)|false|The unit used to display byte values.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|The type of index that wildcard patterns can match.|
|format|query|string|false|A short version of the Accept header, such as `JSON`, `YAML`.|
|h|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of column names to display.|
|health|query|[_common___HealthStatus](#schema_common___healthstatus)|false|The health status used to limit returned indexes. By default, the response includes indexes of any health status.|
|help|query|boolean|false|Return help information.|
|include_unloaded_segments|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes information from segments that are not loaded into memory.|
|local|query|boolean|false|Return local information, do not retrieve the state from cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|next_token|query|null \| string|false|Token to retrieve next page of indexes.|
|pri|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response only includes information from primary shards.|
|s|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of column names or column aliases to sort by.|
|size|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of indexes to be displayed in a page.|
|sort|query|[_common___SortOrder](#schema_common___sortorder)|false|Defines order in which indexes will be displayed. Accepted values are `asc` and `desc`. If `desc`, most recently created indexes would be displayed first.|
|time|query|[_common___TimeUnit](#schema_common___timeunit)|false|The unit used to display time values.|
|v|query|boolean|false|Verbose mode. Display column headers.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|

`GET /_mapping`

Returns mappings for one or more indexes.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/field-types/index/#get-a-mapping">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesgetmapping0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|index|query|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|false|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

## indices.get_field_mapping.0

<a id="opIdindices.get_field_mapping.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_mapping/field/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_mapping/field/{fields}`

Returns mapping for one or more fields.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/field-types/index/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesgetfieldmapping0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fields|path|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|true|A comma-separated list or wildcard expression of fields used to limit returned information.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|include_defaults|query|boolean|false|If `true`, return all default settings in the response.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

> 200 Response

```json
{

    "mappings": {

        "full_name": "string",

          "property1": {},

        }
      },
      "property2": {
        "full_name": "string",
        "mapping": {
          "property1": {},
          "property2": {}
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "property2": {
    "mappings": {
      "property1": {
        "full_name": "string",
        "mapping": {
          "property1": {},
          "property2": {}
        }
      },
      "property2": {
        "full_name": "string",
        "mapping": {
          "property1": {},
          "property2": {}
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## mget.0

<a id="opIdmget.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_mget \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "docs": [
      {
        "_id": "string",
        "_index": "string",
        "routing": "string",
        "_source": true,
        "stored_fields": "string",
        "version": 0,
        "version_type": "external"
      }
    ],
    "ids": "string"
  }'
```

`GET /_mget`

Allows to get multiple documents in one request.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/document-apis/multi-get/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "docs": [
    {
      "_id": "string",
      "_index": "string",
      "routing": "string",
      "_source": true,
      "stored_fields": "string",
      "version": 0,
      "version_type": "external"
    }
  ],
  "ids": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="mget0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|Set to `true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a list of fields to return.|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude from the response.<br>You can also use this parameter to exclude fields from the subset specified in `_source_includes` query parameter.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.<br>If this parameter is specified, only these source fields are returned. You can exclude fields from this subset using the `_source_excludes` query parameter.<br>If the `_source` parameter is `false`, this parameter is ignored.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on. Random by default.|
|realtime|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request is real time as opposed to near real time.|
|refresh|query|[_common___Refresh](#schema_common___refresh)|false|If `true`, the request refreshes relevant shards before retrieving documents.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|stored_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|If `true`, retrieves the document fields stored in the index rather than the document `_source`.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» docs|body|[[_core.mget___Operation](#schema_core.mget___operation)]|false|The documents you want to retrieve. Required if no index is specified in the request URI.|
|» ids|body|[_common___Ids](#schema_common___ids)|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "docs": [
    {
      "_type": "string",
      "_index": "string",
      "fields": {},
      "found": true,
      "_id": "string",
      "_primary_term": 0,
      "_routing": "string",
      "_seq_no": 0,
      "_source": null,
      "_version": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="mget0-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="mget0-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|docs|[[_core.mget___ResponseItem](#schema_core.mget___responseitem)]|true|none|none|

## msearch.0

<a id="opIdmsearch.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_msearch \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-ndjson' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[{"allow_no_indices":true,"expand_wildcards":"all","ignore_unavailable":true,"index":"string","preference":"string","request_cache":true,"routing":"string","search_type":"dfs_query_then_fetch","ccs_minimize_roundtrips":true,"allow_partial_search_results":true,"ignore_throttled":true}]'
```

`GET /_msearch`

Allows to execute several search operations in one request.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/multi-search/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "allow_no_indices": true,
    "expand_wildcards": "all",
    "ignore_unavailable": true,
    "index": "string",
    "preference": "string",
    "request_cache": true,
    "routing": "string",
    "search_type": "dfs_query_then_fetch",
    "ccs_minimize_roundtrips": true,
    "allow_partial_search_results": true,
    "ignore_throttled": true
  }
]
```

<h3 id="msearch0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allow_partial_results|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether to return partial results if there are shard request timeouts or shard failures|
|ccs_minimize_roundtrips|query|boolean|false|If `true`, network round-trips between the coordinating node and remote clusters are minimized for cross-cluster search requests.|
|max_concurrent_searches|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of concurrent searches the multi search API can execute.|
|max_concurrent_shard_requests|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of concurrent shard requests that each sub-search request executes per node.|
|pre_filter_shard_size|query|integer(int32)|false|Defines a threshold that enforces a pre-filter roundtrip to prefilter search shards based on query rewriting if the number of shards the search request expands to exceeds the threshold. This filter roundtrip can limit the number of shards significantly if for instance a shard can not match any documents based on its rewrite method i.e., if date filters are mandatory to match but the shard bounds and the query are disjoint.|
|rest_total_hits_as_int|query|boolean|false|If `true`, `hits.total` are returned as an integer in the response. Defaults to false, which returns an object.|
|search_type|query|[_common___SearchType](#schema_common___searchtype)|false|Indicates whether global term and document frequencies should be used when scoring returned documents.|
|typed_keys|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether aggregation and suggester names should be prefixed by their respective types in the response.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|[[_core.msearch___RequestItem](#schema_core.msearch___requestitem)]|true|none|

## msearch.1

<a id="opIdmsearch.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_msearch \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-ndjson' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[{"allow_no_indices":true,"expand_wildcards":"all","ignore_unavailable":true,"index":"string","preference":"string","request_cache":true,"routing":"string","search_type":"dfs_query_then_fetch","ccs_minimize_roundtrips":true,"allow_partial_search_results":true,"ignore_throttled":true}]'
```

`POST /_msearch`

Allows to execute several search operations in one request.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/multi-search/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "allow_no_indices": true,
    "expand_wildcards": "all",
    "ignore_unavailable": true,
    "index": "string",
    "preference": "string",
    "request_cache": true,
    "routing": "string",
    "search_type": "dfs_query_then_fetch",
    "ccs_minimize_roundtrips": true,
    "allow_partial_search_results": true,
    "ignore_throttled": true
  }
]
```

<h3 id="msearch1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allow_partial_results|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether to return partial results if there are shard request timeouts or shard failures|
|ccs_minimize_roundtrips|query|boolean|false|If `true`, network round-trips between the coordinating node and remote clusters are minimized for cross-cluster search requests.|
|max_concurrent_searches|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of concurrent searches the multi search API can execute.|
|max_concurrent_shard_requests|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of concurrent shard requests that each sub-search request executes per node.|
|pre_filter_shard_size|query|integer(int32)|false|Defines a threshold that enforces a pre-filter roundtrip to prefilter search shards based on query rewriting if the number of shards the search request expands to exceeds the threshold. This filter roundtrip can limit the number of shards significantly if for instance a shard can not match any documents based on its rewrite method i.e., if date filters are mandatory to match but the shard bounds and the query are disjoint.|
|rest_total_hits_as_int|query|boolean|false|If `true`, `hits.total` are returned as an integer in the response. Defaults to false, which returns an object.|
|search_type|query|[_common___SearchType](#schema_common___searchtype)|false|Indicates whether global term and document frequencies should be used when scoring returned documents.|
|typed_keys|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether aggregation and suggester names should be prefixed by their respective types in the response.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|[[_core.msearch___RequestItem](#schema_core.msearch___requestitem)]|true|none|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|_nodes|[_common___NodeStatistics](#schema_common___nodestatistics)|false|none|Contains statistics about the number of nodes selected by the request's node filters.|

|nodes|object|true|none|none|

## nodes.info.1

<a id="opIdnodes.info.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_nodes/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_nodes/{node_id_or_metric}`

Returns information about nodes in the cluster.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/nodes-apis/nodes-info/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="nodesinfo1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|node_id_or_metric|path|[_common___NodeIds](#schema_common___nodeids) \| [[nodes.info___Metric](#schemanodes.info___metric)]|true|Limits the information returned to a list of node IDs or specific metrics.<br>Supports a comma-separated list, such as `node1,node2` or `http,ingest`.<br>|
|flat_settings|query|boolean|false|When `true`, returns settings in flat format.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="nodesinfo1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_nodes|[_common___NodeStatistics](#schema_common___nodestatistics)|false|none|Contains statistics about the number of nodes selected by the request's node filters.|
|cluster_name|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|none|The name of a resource or configuration element.|
|nodes|object|true|none|none|
|» **additionalProperties**|[nodes.info___NodeInfo](#schemanodes.info___nodeinfo)|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## nodes.info.3

<a id="opIdnodes.info.3"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_nodes/string/_all \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_nodes/{node_id}/{metric}`

Returns information about nodes in the cluster.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/nodes-apis/nodes-info/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="nodesinfo3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|metric|path|[[nodes.info___Metric](#schemanodes.info___metric)]|true|Limits the information returned to the specific metrics. Supports a comma-separated list, such as `http,ingest`.|
|node_id|path|[_common___NodeIds](#schema_common___nodeids)|true|A comma-separated list of node IDs or names used to limit returned information.|
|flat_settings|query|boolean|false|When `true`, returns settings in flat format.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

## nodes.hot_threads.6

<a id="opIdnodes.hot_threads.6"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_nodes/string/hot_threads
```

`GET /_nodes/{node_id}/hot_threads`

Returns information about hot threads on each node in the cluster.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/nodes-apis/nodes-hot-threads/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="nodeshotthreads6-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|node_id|path|[string]|true|A comma-separated list of node IDs or names to limit the returned information; use `_local` to return information from the node you're connecting to, leave empty to get information from all nodes.|
|ignore_idle_threads|query|boolean|false|Whether to show threads that are in known-idle places, such as waiting on a socket select or pulling from an empty task queue.|
|interval|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The time interval between thread stack trace samples.|
|snapshots|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of thread stack trace samples to collect.|
|threads|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of threads to provide information for.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|type|query|[nodes._common___SampleType](#schemanodes._common___sampletype)|false|The type to sample.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="nodeshotthreads6-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## nodes.reload_secure_settings.1

<a id="opIdnodes.reload_secure_settings.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_nodes/string/reload_secure_settings \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "secure_settings_password": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /_nodes/{node_id}/reload_secure_settings`

Reloads secure settings.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/nodes-apis/nodes-reload-secure/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "secure_settings_password": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="nodesreloadsecuresettings1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|node_id|path|[_common___NodeIds](#schema_common___nodeids)|true|The names of particular nodes in the cluster to target.|

## nodes.stats.3

<a id="opIdnodes.stats.3"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_nodes/string/stats \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_nodes/{node_id}/stats`

Returns statistical information about nodes in the cluster.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/nodes-apis/nodes-usage/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="nodesstats3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|node_id|path|[_common___NodeIds](#schema_common___nodeids)|true|A comma-separated list of node IDs or names used to limit returned information.|
|completion_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data and suggest statistics.|
|fielddata_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data statistics.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.|
|groups|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.|
|include_segment_file_sizes|query|boolean|false|When `true`,  reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).|
|level|query|[_common___Level](#schema_common___level)|false|Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the cluster, index, or shard level.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|types|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of document types for the indexing index metric.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|level|cluster|
|level|indices|
|level|shards|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|_nodes|[_common___NodeStatistics](#schema_common___nodestatistics)|false|none|Contains statistics about the number of nodes selected by the request's node filters.|
|cluster_name|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|false|none|The name of a resource or configuration element.|
|nodes|object|true|none|none|
|» **additionalProperties**|[nodes.stats___Stats](#schemanodes.stats___stats)|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## nodes.stats.4

<a id="opIdnodes.stats.4"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_nodes/string/stats/_all \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_nodes/{node_id}/stats/{metric}`

Returns statistical information about nodes in the cluster.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/nodes-apis/nodes-usage/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="nodesstats4-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|metric|path|[[nodes.stats___Metric](#schemanodes.stats___metric)]|true|Limit the information returned to the specified metrics.|
|node_id|path|[_common___NodeIds](#schema_common___nodeids)|true|A comma-separated list of node IDs or names used to limit returned information.|
|completion_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data and suggest statistics.|
|fielddata_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data statistics.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.|
|groups|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.|
|include_segment_file_sizes|query|boolean|false|When `true`,  reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).|
|level|query|[_common___Level](#schema_common___level)|false|Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the cluster, index, or shard level.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|types|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of document types for the indexing index metric.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_nodes|[_common___NodeStatistics](#schema_common___nodestatistics)|false|none|Contains statistics about the number of nodes selected by the request's node filters.|
|cluster_name|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|false|none|The name of a resource or configuration element.|
|nodes|object|true|none|none|
|» **additionalProperties**|[nodes.stats___Stats](#schemanodes.stats___stats)|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## nodes.stats.5

<a id="opIdnodes.stats.5"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_nodes/string/stats/_all/_all \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_nodes/{node_id}/stats/{metric}/{index_metric}`

Returns statistical information about nodes in the cluster.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/nodes-apis/nodes-usage/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="nodesstats5-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index_metric|path|[[nodes.stats___IndexMetric](#schemanodes.stats___indexmetric)]|true|Limit the information returned for indexes metric to the specified index metrics. It can be used only if indexes (or all) metric is specified.|
|metric|path|[[nodes.stats___Metric](#schemanodes.stats___metric)]|true|Limit the information returned to the specified metrics.|
|node_id|path|[_common___NodeIds](#schema_common___nodeids)|true|A comma-separated list of node IDs or names used to limit returned information.|
|completion_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data and suggest statistics.|
|fielddata_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data statistics.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.|
|groups|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.|
|include_segment_file_sizes|query|boolean|false|When `true`,  reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).|
|level|query|[_common___Level](#schema_common___level)|false|Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the cluster, index, or shard level.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|types|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of document types for the indexing index metric.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="nodesstats0-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_nodes|[_common___NodeStatistics](#schema_common___nodestatistics)|false|none|Contains statistics about the number of nodes selected by the request's node filters.|
|cluster_name|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|false|none|The name of a resource or configuration element.|
|nodes|object|true|none|none|
|» **additionalProperties**|[nodes.stats___Stats](#schemanodes.stats___stats)|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## nodes.stats.1

<a id="opIdnodes.stats.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_nodes/stats/_all \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_nodes/stats/{metric}`

Returns statistical information about nodes in the cluster.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/nodes-apis/nodes-usage/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="nodesstats1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|metric|path|[[nodes.stats___Metric](#schemanodes.stats___metric)]|true|Limit the information returned to the specified metrics.|
|completion_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data and suggest statistics.|
|fielddata_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data statistics.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.|
|groups|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.|
|include_segment_file_sizes|query|boolean|false|When `true`,  reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).|
|level|query|[_common___Level](#schema_common___level)|false|Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the cluster, index, or shard level.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|types|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of document types for the indexing index metric.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="nodesstats1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_nodes|[_common___NodeStatistics](#schema_common___nodestatistics)|false|none|Contains statistics about the number of nodes selected by the request's node filters.|
|cluster_name|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|false|none|The name of a resource or configuration element.|
|nodes|object|true|none|none|
|» **additionalProperties**|[nodes.stats___Stats](#schemanodes.stats___stats)|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## nodes.stats.2

<a id="opIdnodes.stats.2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_nodes/stats/_all/_all \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_nodes/stats/{metric}/{index_metric}`

Returns statistical information about nodes in the cluster.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/nodes-apis/nodes-usage/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="nodesstats2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index_metric|path|[[nodes.stats___IndexMetric](#schemanodes.stats___indexmetric)]|true|Limit the information returned for indexes metric to the specified index metrics. It can be used only if indexes (or all) metric is specified.|
|metric|path|[[nodes.stats___Metric](#schemanodes.stats___metric)]|true|Limit the information returned to the specified metrics.|
|completion_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data and suggest statistics.|
|fielddata_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data statistics.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.|
|groups|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.|
|include_segment_file_sizes|query|boolean|false|When `true`,  reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).|
|level|query|[_common___Level](#schema_common___level)|false|Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the cluster, index, or shard level.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|types|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of document types for the indexing index metric.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="asynchronoussearchsearch0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|query|string|false|The name of the index to be searched. Can be an individual name, a comma-separated list of indexes, or a wildcard expression of index names.|
|keep_alive|query|string|false|The amount of time that the result is saved in the cluster. For example, `2d` means that the results are stored in the cluster for 48 hours. <br>The saved search results are deleted after this period or if the search is canceled. Note that this includes the query execution time. <br>If the query exceeds this amount of time, the process cancels this query automatically.|
|keep_on_completion|query|boolean|false|Whether to save the results in the cluster after the search is complete. You can examine the stored results at a later time.|
|wait_for_completion_timeout|query|string|false|The amount of time to wait for the results. You can poll the remaining results based on an ID. The maximum value is 300 seconds. Default is `1s`.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|[asynchronous_search._common___Search](#schemaasynchronous_search._common___search)|false|none|
|» aggregations|body|object|false|Defines the aggregations that are run as part of the search request.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[_common.aggregations___AggregationContainer](#schema_common.aggregations___aggregationcontainer)|false|none|
|» collapse|body|[_core.search___FieldCollapse](#schema_core.search___fieldcollapse)|false|none|
|» explain|body|boolean|false|If `true`, returns detailed information about score computation as part of a hit.|
|» ext|body|object|false|Configuration of search extensions defined by OpenSearch plugins.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» from|body|number|false|Starting document offset.<br>Needs to be non-negative.<br>By default, you cannot page through more than 10,000 hits using the `from` and `size` parameters.<br>To page through more hits, use the `search_after` parameter.|
|» highlight|body|[_core.search___Highlight](#schema_core.search___highlight)|false|none|
|» track_total_hits|body|[_core.search___TrackHits](#schema_core.search___trackhits)|false|The number of hits matching the query. When `true`, the exact<br>number of hits is returned at the cost of some performance. When `false`, the<br>response does not include the total number of hits matching the query.<br>Default is `10,000` hits.|
|» indices_boost|body|[object]|false|Boosts the `_score` of documents from specified indexes.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|number|false|none|
|» docvalue_fields|body|[[_common.query_dsl___FieldAndFormat](#schema_common.query_dsl___fieldandformat)]|false|Array of wildcard (`*`) patterns.<br>The request returns doc values for field names matching these patterns in the `hits.fields` property of the response.|
|» min_score|body|number|false|Minimum `_score` for matching documents.<br>Documents with a lower `_score` are not included in the search results.|
|» post_filter|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» profile|body|boolean|false|Set to `true` to return detailed timing information about the execution of individual components in a search request.<br>NOTE: This is a debugging tool and adds significant overhead to search execution.|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» script_fields|body|object|false|Retrieve a script evaluation (based on different fields) for each hit.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[_common___ScriptField](#schema_common___scriptfield)|false|The configuration for a script field.|
|» search_after|body|[_common___SortResults](#schema_common___sortresults)|false|none|
|» size|body|number|false|The number of hits to return.<br>By default, you cannot page through more than 10,000 hits using the `from` and `size` parameters.<br>To page through more hits, use the `search_after` parameter.|
|» slice|body|[_common___SlicedScroll](#schema_common___slicedscroll)|false|The configuration for a sliced scroll request.|
|» sort|body|[_common___Sort](#schema_common___sort)|false|none|
|» _source|body|[_core.search___SourceConfig](#schema_core.search___sourceconfig)|false|Defines how to fetch a source. Fetching can be disabled entirely, or the source can be filtered.|
|» fields|body|[[_common.query_dsl___FieldAndFormat](#schema_common.query_dsl___fieldandformat)]|false|Array of wildcard (`*`) patterns.<br>The request returns values for field names matching these patterns in the `hits.fields` property of the response.|
|» suggest|body|[_core.search___Suggester](#schema_core.search___suggester)|false|none|
|» terminate_after|body|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of documents to collect for each shard.<br>If a query reaches this limit, OpenSearch terminates the query early.<br>OpenSearch collects documents before sorting.<br>Use with caution.<br>OpenSearch applies this parameter to each shard handling the request.<br>When possible, let OpenSearch perform early termination automatically.<br>Avoid specifying this parameter for requests that target data streams with backing indexes across multiple data tiers.<br>If set to `0` (default), the query does not terminate early.|
|» timeout|body|string|false|Specifies the period of time to wait for a response from each shard.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.<br>Defaults to no timeout.|
|» track_scores|body|boolean|false|If `true`, calculate and return document scores, even if the scores are not used for sorting.|
|» version|body|boolean|false|If `true`, returns document version as part of a hit.|
|» seq_no_primary_term|body|boolean|false|If `true`, returns sequence number and primary term of the last modification of each hit.|
|» stored_fields|body|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or a wildcard expression specifying the fields to include in the statistics.<br>Used as the default list unless a specific field list is provided in the `completion_fields` or `fielddata_fields` parameters.|
|» pit|body|[_core.search___PointInTimeReference](#schema_core.search___pointintimereference)|false|none|
|» stats|body|[string]|false|Stats groups to associate with the search.<br>Each group maintains a statistics aggregation for its associated searches.<br>You can retrieve these stats using the indexes stats API.|

## asynchronous_search.get.0

<a id="opIdasynchronous_search.get.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_plugins/_asynchronous_search/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_plugins/_asynchronous_search/{id}`

Gets partial responses from an asynchronous search.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/search-plugins/async/index/#get-partial-results">External documentation</a>

|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|


`POST /_plugins/_flow_framework/workflow`

Creates a new workflow template.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/automating-configurations/api/create-workflow/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "use_case": "string",
  "version": {
    "template": "string",
    "compatibility": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "workflows": {}
}
```

<h3 id="flowframeworkcreate0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|provision|query|[flow_framework.common___Provision](#schemaflow_framework.common___provision)|false|none|
|reprovision|query|[flow_framework.common___Reprovision](#schemaflow_framework.common___reprovision)|false|none|
|update_fields|query|[flow_framework.common___UpdateFields](#schemaflow_framework.common___updatefields)|false|none|
|use_case|query|[flow_framework.common___UseCase](#schemaflow_framework.common___usecase)|false|Specifies the workflow template to use.|
|validation|query|[flow_framework.common___Validation](#schemaflow_framework.common___validation)|false|none|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|[flow_framework.common___FlowFrameworkCreate](#schemaflow_framework.common___flowframeworkcreate)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the workflow.|
|» description|body|string|false|A description of the workflow.|
|» use_case|body|string|false|A use case ID, which can be used with the Search Workflow API to find related workflows.|
|» version|body|[flow_framework.common___version](#schemaflow_framework.common___version)|false|A key-value map with two fields, template, which identifies the template version, and compatibility, which identifies a list of minimum required OpenSearch versions.|
|» workflows|body|object|false|A map of workflows. Presently, only the provision key is supported. The value for the workflow key is a key-value map that includes fields for `user_params` and lists of nodes and edges.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "workflow_id": "string"
}
```

> 202 Response

```json
{
  "workflow_id": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string",
  "status": 0
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string",
  "status": 0
}
```

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|workflow_id|string|true|none|The ID of the workflow.|

Status Code **202**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|workflow_id|string|true|none|The ID of the workflow to be updated. Required for the PUT method.|

Status Code **400**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___InvalidParameterError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___invalidparametererror)|false|none|Indicates that invalid parameters were provided in the request.|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___ConflictError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___conflicterror)|false|none|Indicates that conflicting parameters were provided in the request.|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___MissingParameterError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___missingparametererror)|false|none|Indicates that required parameters are missing from the request.|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___ParameterConflictError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___parameterconflicterror)|false|none|Indicates that mutually exclusive parameters were provided in the request.|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___MaxWorkflowsLimitError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___maxworkflowslimiterror)|false|none|Indicates that the maximum number of workflows has been reached.|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___WorkflowSaveError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___workflowsaveerror)|false|none|Indicates that the workflow state could not be saved.|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___WorkflowParsingError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___workflowparsingerror)|false|none|Indicates that the workflow template could not be parsed.|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___UnsupportedFieldUpdateError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___unsupportedfieldupdateerror)|false|none|Indicates an attempt to update a field that cannot be modified independently.|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___InvalidTemplateVersionError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___invalidtemplateversionerror)|false|none|Indicates that the template version is invalid or missing.|
|*anyOf*|[flow_framework.errors___TemplateNameRequiredError](#schemaflow_framework.errors___templatenamerequirederror)|false|none|Indicates that the template name is missing from the request.|

<h3 id="flowframeworksearchstate1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|[flow_framework.common___SearchWorkflowRequest](#schemaflow_framework.common___searchworkflowrequest)|true|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|The query used to search for workflows.|

|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» input_query|body|[ml._common___InputQuery](#schemaml._common___inputquery)|false|none|
|» input_index|body|[string]|false|The input index.|
|» text_docs|body|[string]|false|The text documents.|
|» return_number|body|boolean|false|Whether to return bytes in model output.|
|» target_response|body|[string]|false|The target response.|

<h3 id="mltrain0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|algorithm_name|path|string|true|none|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» parameters|body|[ml._common___TrainParameters](#schemaml._common___trainparameters)|false|none|
|» input_query|body|[ml._common___InputQuery](#schemaml._common___inputquery)|false|none|
|» input_index|body|[string]|false|The input index.|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "model_id": "string",
  "status": "CANCELLED"
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[ml._common___TrainResponse](#schemaml._common___trainresponse)|

<h3 id="mlsearchconnectors1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» size|body|integer(int64)|false|The number of connectors to return.|
|» sort|body|[_common___Sort](#schema_common___sort)|false|The sort order.|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|memory_container_id|path|string|true|none|
|type|path|string|true|none|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» size|body|integer(int64)|false|The number of memory containers to return.|
|» sort|body|[_common___Sort](#schema_common___sort)|false|none|

<h3 id="mlsearchmemory0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» size|body|integer(int64)|false|The number of memories to return.|
|» sort|body|[_common___Sort](#schema_common___sort)|false|The sort order.|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|memory_id|path|string|true|none|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» size|body|integer(int64)|false|The number of messages to return.|
|» sort|body|[_common___Sort](#schema_common___sort)|false|The sort order.|

```bash
  }'
```

`POST /_plugins/_ml/model_groups/_register`

Registers a model group.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "access_mode": "private",
  "backend_roles": [
    "string"
  ],
  "add_all_backend_roles": true
}
```

<h3 id="mlregistermodelgroup0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The model group name.|
|» description|body|string|false|The model group description.|
|» access_mode|body|[ml._common___ModelGroupAccessMode](#schemaml._common___modelgroupaccessmode)|false|The model group access mode.|
|» backend_roles|body|[string]|false|The backend roles.|
|» add_all_backend_roles|body|boolean|false|The add all backend roles.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» access_mode|private|
|» access_mode|public|
|» access_mode|restricted|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "model_group_id": "string",
  "status": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="mlregistermodelgroup0-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[ml._common___ModelGroupRegistration](#schemaml._common___modelgroupregistration)|

This operation does not require authentication

<h3 id="mlsearchmodels1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» size|body|integer(int64)|false|The number of models to return.|
|» sort|body|[_common___Sort](#schema_common___sort)|false|The sort order.|

## ml.get_stats.1

<a id="opIdml.get_stats.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_plugins/_ml/stats/ml_config_index_status \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_plugins/_ml/stats/{stat}`

Get stats.

<h3 id="mlgetstats1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|stat|path|[ml._common___MlStatName](#schemaml._common___mlstatname) \| [[ml._common___MlStatName](#schemaml._common___mlstatname)]|true|none|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

`GET /_plugins/_neural/{node_id}/stats`

Provides information about the current status of the neural-search plugin.

<h3 id="neuralstats2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|node_id|path|string|true|A comma-separated list of node IDs or names to limit the returned information; leave empty to get information from all nodes.|
|flat_stat_paths|query|boolean|false|Whether to return stats in the flat form, which can improve readability, especially for heavily nested stats.<br>For example, the flat form of `"processors": { "ingest": { "text_embedding_executions": 20181212 } }` is <br>`"processors.ingest.text_embedding_executions": "20181212"`.|
|include_all_nodes|query|boolean|false|When `true` includes aggregated statistics across all nodes in the `all_nodes` category.<br>When `false`, excludes the `all_nodes` category from the response.|
|include_individual_nodes|query|boolean|false|When `true` includes statistics for individual nodes in the `nodes` category.<br>When `false`, excludes the `nodes` category from the response.|
|include_info|query|boolean|false|When `true` includes cluster-wide information in the `info` category.<br>When `false`, excludes the `info` category from the response.|
|include_metadata|query|boolean|false|Whether to return stat metadata instead of the raw stat value, includes additional information about the stat.<br>These can include things like type hints, time since last stats being recorded, or recent rolling interval values|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="neuralstats0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|flat_stat_paths|query|boolean|false|Whether to return stats in the flat form, which can improve readability, especially for heavily nested stats.<br>For example, the flat form of `"processors": { "ingest": { "text_embedding_executions": 20181212 } }` is <br>`"processors.ingest.text_embedding_executions": "20181212"`.|
|include_all_nodes|query|boolean|false|When `true` includes aggregated statistics across all nodes in the `all_nodes` category.<br>When `false`, excludes the `all_nodes` category from the response.|
|include_individual_nodes|query|boolean|false|When `true` includes statistics for individual nodes in the `nodes` category.<br>When `false`, excludes the `nodes` category from the response.|
|include_info|query|boolean|false|When `true` includes cluster-wide information in the `info` category.<br>When `false`, excludes the `info` category from the response.|
|include_metadata|query|boolean|false|Whether to return stat metadata instead of the raw stat value, includes additional information about the stat.<br>These can include things like type hints, time since last stats being recorded, or recent rolling interval values|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
