<h3 id="snapshotrestore0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|repository|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|The name of the repository containing the snapshot|
|snapshot|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|The name of the snapshot to restore.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response from the cluster manager node. For more information about supported time units, see [Common parameters](https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/common-parameters/#time-units).|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Explicit operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|-\| Whether to return a response after the restore operation has completed. When `false`, the request returns a response when the restore operation initializes. When `true`, the request returns a response when the restore operation completes.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» ignore_index_settings|body|[string]|false|A comma-delimited list of index settings to ignore when restoring indexes from a snapshot.|
|» ignore_unavailable|body|boolean|false|How to handle data streams or indexes that are missing or closed. <br>When `false`, the request returns an error for any data stream or index that is missing or closed. <br>When `true`, the request ignores data streams and indexes in indexes that are missing or closed. |
|» include_aliases|body|boolean|false|How to handle index aliases from the original snapshot. <br>When `true`, index aliases from the original snapshot are restored. <br>When `false`, aliases along with associated indexes are not restored. |
|» include_global_state|body|boolean|false|Whether to restore the current cluster state. When `false`, the cluster state is not restored. <br>When `true`, the current cluster state is restored. |
|» index_settings|body|[indices._common___IndexSettings](#schemaindices._common___indexsettings)|false|A comma-delimited list of settings to add or change in all restored indexes. <br>Use this parameter to override index settings during snapshot restoration. <br>For data streams, these index settings are applied to the restored backing indexes.|
|» indices|body|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|false|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|» partial|body|boolean|false|How the restore operation will behave if indexes in the snapshot do not have all primary shards available.<br>When `false`, the entire restore operation fails if any indexes in the snapshot do not have all primary shards available.<br>When `true`, allows the restoration of a partial snapshot of indexes with unavailable shards. Only shards that were successfully included in the snapshot are restored. <br>All missing shards are recreated as empty. By default, the entire restore operation fails if one or more indexes included in the snapshot do not have all primary shards available. To change this behavior, set `partial` to `true`.|
|» rename_pattern|body|string|false|The pattern to apply to the restored data streams and indexes. Data streams and indexes matching the rename pattern will be renamed according to the `rename_replacement` setting.<br>The rename pattern is applied as defined by the regular expression that supports referencing the original text.<br>The request fails if two or more data streams or indexes are renamed into the same name.<br>If you rename a restored data stream, its backing indexes are also renamed. For example, if you rename the logs data stream to `recovered-logs`, the backing index `.ds-logs-1` is renamed to `.ds-recovered-logs-1`.<br>If you rename a restored stream, ensure an index template matches the new stream name. If there are no matching index template names, the stream cannot roll over and new backing indexes are not created.|
|» rename_replacement|body|string|false|The rename replacement string.|
|» rename_alias_pattern|body|string|false|The pattern to apply to the restored aliases. Aliases matching the rename pattern will be renamed according to the `rename_alias_replacement` setting.<br>The rename pattern is applied as defined by the regular expression that supports referencing the original text.<br>If two or more aliases are renamed into the same name, these aliases will be merged into one.|
|» rename_alias_replacement|body|string|false|The rename replacement string for aliases.|
|» source_remote_store_repository|body|string|false|The name of the remote store repository of the source index being restored. If not provided, the Snapshot Restore API will use the repository that was registered when the snapshot was created.|
|» storage_type|body|string|false|Where will be the authoritative store of the restored indexes' data.<br>A value of `local` indicates that all snapshot metadata and index data will be downloaded to local storage.<br>A value of `remote_snapshot` indicates that snapshot metadata will be downloaded to the cluster, but the remote repository will remain the authoritative store of the index data. Data will be downloaded and cached as necessary to service queries. At least one node in the cluster must be configured with the search role in order to restore a snapshot using the type `remote_snapshot`.|

## snapshot.status.2

<a id="opIdsnapshot.status.2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_snapshot/string/string/_status \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_snapshot/{repository}/{snapshot}/_status`

Returns information about the status of a snapshot.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/snapshots/get-snapshot-status/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="snapshotstatus2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|repository|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|The name of the repository containing the snapshot.|
|snapshot|path|[_common___Names](#schema_common___names)|true|A comma-separated list of snapshot names.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response from the cluster manager node. For more information about supported time units, see [Common parameters](https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/common-parameters/#time-units).|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|Whether to ignore any unavailable snapshots, When `false`, a `SnapshotMissingException` is thrown.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Explicit operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

## indices.stats.0

<a id="opIdindices.stats.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_stats \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_stats`

Provides statistics on operations happening in an index.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesstats0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|completion_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data and suggest statistics.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match. If the request can target data streams, this argument<br>determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams. Supports comma-separated values,<br>such as `open,hidden`.|
|fielddata_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data statistics.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.|
|forbid_closed_indices|query|boolean|false|If `true`, statistics are not collected from closed indexes.|
|groups|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.|
|include_segment_file_sizes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the call reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).|
|include_unloaded_segments|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes information from segments that are not loaded into memory.|
|level|query|[_common___Level](#schema_common___level)|false|Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the cluster, index, or shard level.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|level|cluster|
|level|indices|
|level|shards|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="indicesstats0-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_shards|[_common___ShardStatistics](#schema_common___shardstatistics)|true|none|none|
|_all|[indices.stats___AllIndicesStats](#schemaindices.stats___allindicesstats)|true|none|The statistics for all indexes.|
|indices|object|false|none|none|
|» **additionalProperties**|[indices.stats___IndicesStats](#schemaindices.stats___indicesstats)|false|none|The statistics for specific indexes.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## indices.stats.1

<a id="opIdindices.stats.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_stats/_all \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_stats/{metric}`

Provides statistics on operations happening in an index.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesstats1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|metric|path|[indices.stats___Metric](#schemaindices.stats___metric) \| [[indices.stats___Metric](#schemaindices.stats___metric)]|true|Limit the information returned the specific metrics.|
|completion_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data and suggest statistics.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match. If the request can target data streams, this argument<br>determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams. Supports comma-separated values,<br>such as `open,hidden`.|
|fielddata_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data statistics.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.|
|forbid_closed_indices|query|boolean|false|If `true`, statistics are not collected from closed indexes.|
|groups|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.|
|include_segment_file_sizes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the call reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).|
|include_unloaded_segments|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes information from segments that are not loaded into memory.|
|level|query|[_common___Level](#schema_common___level)|false|Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the cluster, index, or shard level.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|level|cluster|
|level|indices|
|level|shards|

## tasks.list.0

<a id="opIdtasks.list.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_tasks \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_tasks`

Returns a list of tasks.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/tasks/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="taskslist0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|actions|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of actions that should be returned. Keep empty to return all.|
|detailed|query|boolean|false|When `true`, the response includes detailed information about shard recoveries.|
|group_by|query|[tasks._common___GroupBy](#schematasks._common___groupby)|false|Groups tasks by parent/child relationships or nodes.|
|nodes|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of node IDs or names used to limit the returned information. Use `_local` to return information from the node you're connecting to, specify the node name to get information from a specific node, or keep the parameter empty to get information from all nodes.|
|parent_task_id|query|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|false|Returns tasks with a specified parent task ID (`node_id:task_number`). Keep empty or set to -1 to return all.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The amount of time to wait for a response.|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|Waits for the matching task to complete. When `true`, the request is blocked until the task has completed.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|group_by|nodes|
|group_by|none|
|group_by|parents|

## tasks.cancel.0

<a id="opIdtasks.cancel.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_tasks/_cancel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /_tasks/_cancel`

Cancels a task, if it can be cancelled through an API.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/tasks/#task-canceling">External documentation</a>

## tasks.cancel.1

<a id="opIdtasks.cancel.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_tasks/string/_cancel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /_tasks/{task_id}/_cancel`

Cancels a task, if it can be cancelled through an API.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/tasks/#task-canceling">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="taskscancel1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|task_id|path|[_common___TaskId](#schema_common___taskid)|true|The task ID.|
|actions|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of actions that should be returned. Keep empty to return all.|
|nodes|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of node IDs or names used to limit the returned information. Use `_local` to return information from the node you're connecting to, specify the node name to get information from a specific node, or keep the parameter empty to get information from all nodes.|
|parent_task_id|query|string|false|Returns tasks with a specified parent task ID (`node_id:task_number`). Keep empty or set to -1 to return all.|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|Waits for the matching task to complete. When `true`, the request is blocked until the task has completed.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

## indices.get_template.0

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_template`

Returns an index template.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesgettemplate0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|

## indices.get_template.1

<a id="opIdindices.get_template.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/_template/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /_template/{name}`

Returns an index template.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesgettemplate1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|[_common___Names](#schema_common___names)|true|A comma-separated list of index template names used to limit the request.<br>Wildcard (`*`) expressions are supported.<br>To return all index templates, omit this parameter or use a value of `_all` or `*`.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|flat_settings|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns settings in flat format.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="indicesputtemplate1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|The name of the template|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|create|query|boolean|false|If `true`, this request cannot replace or update existing index templates.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node. If no response is<br>received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|order|query|integer(int32)|false|Order in which OpenSearch applies this template if index<br>matches multiple templates.<br><br>Templates with lower 'order' values are merged first. Templates with higher<br>'order' values are merged later, overriding templates with lower values.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» aliases|body|object|false|Aliases for the index.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[indices._common___Alias](#schemaindices._common___alias)|false|The index alias configuration.|
|» index_patterns|body|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|Array of wildcard expressions used to match the names<br>of indexes during creation.|
|» mappings|body|[_common.mapping___TypeMapping](#schema_common.mapping___typemapping)|false|none|
|» order|body|integer(int32)|false|Order in which OpenSearch applies this template if index<br>matches multiple templates.<br><br>Templates with lower 'order' values are merged first. Templates with higher<br>'order' values are merged later, overriding templates with lower values.|
|» settings|body|object|false|Configuration options for the index.|
|» version|body|[_common___VersionNumber](#schema_common___versionnumber)|false|none|

`GET /_validate/query`

Allows a user to validate a potentially expensive query without executing it.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesvalidatequery0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|all_shards|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the validation is executed on all shards instead of one random shard per index.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: `AND` or `OR`.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|explain|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns detailed information if an error has occurred.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|lenient|query|boolean|false|If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.|
|q|query|string|false|Query in the Lucene query string syntax.|
|rewrite|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns a more detailed explanation showing the actual Lucene query that will be executed.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|

<h3 id="indicesrollover0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alias|path|[_common___IndexAlias](#schema_common___indexalias)|true|Name of the data stream or index alias to roll over.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|dry_run|query|boolean|false|If `true`, checks whether the current index satisfies the specified conditions but does not perform a rollover.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to all or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» aliases|body|object|false|Aliases for the target index.<br>Data streams do not support this parameter.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[indices._common___Alias](#schemaindices._common___alias)|false|The index alias configuration.|
|» conditions|body|[indices.rollover___RolloverConditions](#schemaindices.rollover___rolloverconditions)|false|The conditions that trigger an index rollover.|
|» mappings|body|[_common.mapping___TypeMapping](#schema_common.mapping___typemapping)|false|none|
|» settings|body|object|false|Configuration options for the index.<br>Data streams do not support this parameter.|

`POST /{alias}/_rollover/{new_index}`

Updates an alias to point to a new index when the existing index
is considered to be too large or too old.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/dashboards/im-dashboards/rollover/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesrollover1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alias|path|[_common___IndexAlias](#schema_common___indexalias)|true|Name of the data stream or index alias to roll over.|
|new_index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|The name of the index to create.<br>Supports date math.<br>Data streams do not support this parameter.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|dry_run|query|boolean|false|If `true`, checks whether the current index satisfies the specified conditions but does not perform a rollover.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to all or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» aliases|body|object|false|Aliases for the target index.<br>Data streams do not support this parameter.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[indices._common___Alias](#schemaindices._common___alias)|false|The index alias configuration.|
|» conditions|body|[indices.rollover___RolloverConditions](#schemaindices.rollover___rolloverconditions)|false|The conditions that trigger an index rollover.|
|» mappings|body|[_common.mapping___TypeMapping](#schema_common.mapping___typemapping)|false|none|
|» settings|body|object|false|Configuration options for the index.<br>Data streams do not support this parameter.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "acknowledged": true,
  "conditions": {
    "property1": true,
    "property2": true
  },
  "dry_run": true,
  "new_index": "string",
  "old_index": "string",
  "rolled_over": true,
  "shards_acknowledged": true
}
```

<h3 id="indicesrollover1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="indicesrollover1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acknowledged|boolean|true|none|For a successful response, this value is always true. On failure, an exception is returned instead.|
|conditions|object|true|none|none|
|» **additionalProperties**|boolean|false|none|none|
|dry_run|boolean|true|none|none|
|new_index|string|true|none|none|
|old_index|string|true|none|none|
|rolled_over|boolean|true|none|none|
|shards_acknowledged|boolean|true|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## indices.get.0

<a id="opIdindices.get.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}`

Returns information about one or more indexes.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/index-apis/get-index/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesget0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and index aliases used to limit the request.<br>Wildcard expressions (*) are supported.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only<br>missing or closed indexes. This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes. For example,<br>a request targeting foo*,bar* returns an error if an index starts with foo but no index starts with bar.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard expressions can match. If the request can target data streams, this argument<br>determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams. Supports comma-separated values,<br>such as `open,hidden`.|
|flat_settings|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns settings in flat format.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, requests that target a missing index return an error.|
|include_defaults|query|boolean|false|If `true`, return all default settings in the response.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only. Defaults to false, which means information is retrieved from the cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation. <br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

|» mappings|body|[_common.mapping___TypeMapping](#schema_common.mapping___typemapping)|false|none|
|» settings|body|[indices._common___IndexSettings](#schemaindices._common___indexsettings)|false|The configuration settings for an index.|

## indices.delete.0

<a id="opIdindices.delete.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`DELETE /{index}`

Deletes an index.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/index-apis/delete-index/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesdelete0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of indexes to delete.<br>You cannot specify index aliases.<br>By default, this parameter does not support wildcards (`*`) or `_all`.<br>To use wildcards or `_all`, set the `action.destructive_requires_name` cluster setting to `false`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

`HEAD /{index}`

Returns information about whether a particular index exists.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/index-apis/exists/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesexists0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases. Supports wildcards (`*`).|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|

|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|include_defaults|query|boolean|false|If `true`, return all default settings in the response.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||None|

## indices.get_alias.2

<a id="opIdindices.get_alias.2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_alias \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}/_alias`

Returns an alias.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/im-plugin/index-alias/">External documentation</a>

|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|

<h3 id="indicesputalias5-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams or indexes to add.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>Wildcard patterns that match both data streams and indexes return an error.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» alias|body|string|false|none|
|» filter|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» index|body|string|false|none|
|» index_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_write_index|body|boolean|false|If `true`, sets the write index or data stream for the alias.<br>If an alias points to multiple indexes or data streams and `is_write_index` isn't set, the alias rejects write requests.<br>If an index alias points to one index and `is_write_index` isn't set, the index automatically acts as the write index.<br>Data stream aliases don't automatically set a write data stream, even if the alias points to one data stream.|
|» routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» search_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_hidden|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the alias will be hidden`.|

```json
}
```

## indices.get_alias.3

<a id="opIdindices.get_alias.3"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_alias/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}/_alias/{name}`

Returns an alias.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/im-plugin/index-alias/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesgetalias3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams or indexes used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|name|path|[_common___Names](#schema_common___names)|true|A comma-separated list of aliases to retrieve.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To retrieve all aliases, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="indicesputalias7-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams or indexes to add.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>Wildcard patterns that match both data streams and indexes return an error.|
|name|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|Alias to update.<br>If the alias doesn't exist, the request creates it.<br>Index alias names support date math.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» alias|body|string|false|none|
|» filter|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» index|body|string|false|none|
|» index_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_write_index|body|boolean|false|If `true`, sets the write index or data stream for the alias.<br>If an alias points to multiple indexes or data streams and `is_write_index` isn't set, the alias rejects write requests.<br>If an index alias points to one index and `is_write_index` isn't set, the index automatically acts as the write index.<br>Data stream aliases don't automatically set a write data stream, even if the alias points to one data stream.|
|» routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» search_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_hidden|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the alias will be hidden`.|

```json
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

<h3 id="indicesputalias6-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams or indexes to add.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>Wildcard patterns that match both data streams and indexes return an error.|
|name|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|Alias to update.<br>If the alias doesn't exist, the request creates it.<br>Index alias names support date math.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» alias|body|string|false|none|
|» filter|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» index|body|string|false|none|
|» index_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_write_index|body|boolean|false|If `true`, sets the write index or data stream for the alias.<br>If an alias points to multiple indexes or data streams and `is_write_index` isn't set, the alias rejects write requests.<br>If an index alias points to one index and `is_write_index` isn't set, the index automatically acts as the write index.<br>Data stream aliases don't automatically set a write data stream, even if the alias points to one data stream.|
|» routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» search_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_hidden|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the alias will be hidden`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "acknowledged": true
}
```

<h3 id="indicesputalias6-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[_common___AcknowledgedResponseBase](#schema_common___acknowledgedresponsebase)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## indices.delete_alias.0

<a id="opIdindices.delete_alias.0"></a>

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_alias/string \
```

`DELETE /{index}/_alias/{name}`

Deletes an alias.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/im-plugin/index-alias/#delete-aliases">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesdeletealias0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams or indexes used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).|

`HEAD /{index}/_alias/{name}`

Returns information about whether a particular alias exists.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesexistsalias1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams or indexes used to limit the request. Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|name|path|[_common___Names](#schema_common___names)|true|A comma-separated list of aliases to check. Supports wildcards (`*`).|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, requests that include a missing data stream or index in the target indexes or data streams return an error.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="indicesexistsalias1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||None|
|404|Not Found||None|

<h3 id="indicesputalias8-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams or indexes to add.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>Wildcard patterns that match both data streams and indexes return an error.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» alias|body|string|false|none|
|» filter|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» index|body|string|false|none|
|» index_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_write_index|body|boolean|false|If `true`, sets the write index or data stream for the alias.<br>If an alias points to multiple indexes or data streams and `is_write_index` isn't set, the alias rejects write requests.<br>If an index alias points to one index and `is_write_index` isn't set, the index automatically acts as the write index.<br>Data stream aliases don't automatically set a write data stream, even if the alias points to one data stream.|
|» routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» search_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_hidden|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the alias will be hidden`.|

```json
}
```

<h3 id="indicesputalias10-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams or indexes to add.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>Wildcard patterns that match both data streams and indexes return an error.|
|name|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|Alias to update.<br>If the alias doesn't exist, the request creates it.<br>Index alias names support date math.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» alias|body|string|false|none|
|» filter|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» index|body|string|false|none|
|» index_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_write_index|body|boolean|false|If `true`, sets the write index or data stream for the alias.<br>If an alias points to multiple indexes or data streams and `is_write_index` isn't set, the alias rejects write requests.<br>If an index alias points to one index and `is_write_index` isn't set, the index automatically acts as the write index.<br>Data stream aliases don't automatically set a write data stream, even if the alias points to one data stream.|
|» routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» search_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_hidden|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the alias will be hidden`.|

<h3 id="indicesputalias9-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams or indexes to add.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>Wildcard patterns that match both data streams and indexes return an error.|
|name|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|Alias to update.<br>If the alias doesn't exist, the request creates it.<br>Index alias names support date math.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» alias|body|string|false|none|
|» filter|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|
|» index|body|string|false|none|
|» index_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_write_index|body|boolean|false|If `true`, sets the write index or data stream for the alias.<br>If an alias points to multiple indexes or data streams and `is_write_index` isn't set, the alias rejects write requests.<br>If an index alias points to one index and `is_write_index` isn't set, the index automatically acts as the write index.<br>Data stream aliases don't automatically set a write data stream, even if the alias points to one data stream.|
|» routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» search_routing|body|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|The routing value for the document.|
|» is_hidden|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the alias will be hidden`.|

> Example responses

```json
  "acknowledged": true
}
```

|name|path|[_common___Names](#schema_common___names)|true|A comma-separated list of aliases to remove.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`). To remove all aliases, use `*` or `_all`.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|

|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

`GET /{index}/_analyze`

Performs the analysis process on a text and return the tokens breakdown of the text.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/analyze-apis/perform-text-analysis/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "analyzer": "string",
  "attributes": [
    "string"
  ],
  "char_filter": [
    "string"
  ],
  "explain": true,
  "field": "string",
  "filter": [
    "string"
  ],
  "normalizer": "string",
  "text": "string",
  "tokenizer": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="indicesanalyze2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Index used to derive the analyzer.<br>If specified, the `analyzer` or field parameter overrides this value.<br>If no index is specified or the index does not have a default analyzer, the analyze API uses the standard analyzer.|
|index|query|string|false|The name of the index to scope the operation.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» analyzer|body|string|false|The name of the analyzer that should be applied to the provided `text`.<br>This could be a built-in analyzer, or an analyzer that's been configured in the index.|
|» attributes|body|[string]|false|Array of token attributes used to filter the output of the `explain` parameter.|
|» char_filter|body|[[_common.analysis___CharFilter](#schema_common.analysis___charfilter)]|false|Array of character filters used to preprocess characters before the tokenizer.|
|» explain|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes token attributes and additional details.|
|» field|body|[_common___Field](#schema_common___field)|false|The path to a field or an array of paths. Some APIs support wildcards in the path, which allows you to select multiple fields.|
|» filter|body|[[_common.analysis___TokenFilter](#schema_common.analysis___tokenfilter)]|false|Array of token filters used to apply after the tokenizer.|
|» normalizer|body|string|false|Normalizer to use to convert text into a single token.|
|» text|body|[indices.analyze___TextToAnalyze](#schemaindices.analyze___texttoanalyze)|false|none|
|» tokenizer|body|[_common.analysis___Tokenizer](#schema_common.analysis___tokenizer)|false|none|

`POST /{index}/_analyze`

Performs the analysis process on a text and return the tokens breakdown of the text.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/analyze-apis/perform-text-analysis/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "analyzer": "string",
  "attributes": [
    "string"
  ],
  "char_filter": [
    "string"
  ],
  "explain": true,
  "field": "string",
  "filter": [
    "string"
  ],
  "normalizer": "string",
  "text": "string",
  "tokenizer": "string"
}
```

`PUT /{index}/_bulk/stream`

Allows to perform multiple index/update/delete operations using request response streaming.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/document-apis/bulk-streaming/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
[
  {

      "routing": "string",
      "pipeline": "string",
      "require_alias": true,
      "if_primary_term": 0,
      "if_seq_no": 0,
      "op_type": "create",
      "version": 0,
      "version_type": "external"
    },
    "create": {
      "_id": "string",
      "_index": "string",
      "routing": "string",
      "pipeline": "string",
      "require_alias": true
    },
    "update": {
      "_id": "string",
      "_index": "string",
      "routing": "string",
      "if_primary_term": 0,
      "if_seq_no": 0,
      "require_alias": true,
      "retry_on_conflict": 0
    },
    "delete": {
      "_id": "string",
      "_index": "string",
      "routing": "string",
      "if_primary_term": 0,
      "if_seq_no": 0,
      "version": 0,
      "version_type": "external"
    }
  }
]
```

<h3 id="bulkstream3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the data stream, index, or index alias to perform bulk actions on.|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|`true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a list of fields to return.|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude from the response.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.|
|batch_interval|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Specifies for how long bulk operations should be accumulated into a batch before sending the batch to data nodes.|
|batch_size|query|[_common___BatchSize](#schema_common___batchsize)|false|Specifies how many bulk operations should be accumulated into a batch before sending the batch to data nodes.|
|pipeline|query|string|false|ID of the pipeline to use to preprocess incoming documents.<br>If the index has a default ingest pipeline specified, then setting the value to `_none` disables the default ingest pipeline for this request.<br>If a final pipeline is configured it will always run, regardless of the value of this parameter.|
|refresh|query|[_common___Refresh](#schema_common___refresh)|false|If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes the affected shards to make this operation visible to search, if `wait_for` then wait for a refresh to make this operation visible to search, if `false` do nothing with refreshes.<br>Valid values: `true`, `false`, `wait_for`.|
|require_alias|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request's actions must target an index alias.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period each action waits for the following operations: automatic index creation, dynamic mapping updates, waiting for active shards.|
|type|query|string|false|Default document type for items which don't provide one.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to all or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|[[_core.bulk___OperationContainer](#schema_core.bulk___operationcontainer) \| [_core.bulk___UpdateAction](#schema_core.bulk___updateaction) \| object]|true|none|
|» *anyOf*|body|[_core.bulk___OperationContainer](#schema_core.bulk___operationcontainer)|false|none|
|» *anyOf*|body|[_core.bulk___UpdateAction](#schema_core.bulk___updateaction)|false|none|
|» *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|

## indices.clear_cache.1

<a id="opIdindices.clear_cache.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_cache/clear \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /{index}/_cache/clear`

Clears all or specific caches for one or more indexes.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/index-apis/clear-index-cache/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesclearcache1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|fielddata|query|boolean|false|If `true`, clears the fields cache.<br>Use the `fields` parameter to clear the cache of specific fields only.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of field names used to limit the `fielddata` parameter.|
|file|query|boolean|false|If `true`, clears the unused entries from the file cache on nodes with the Search role.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|index|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of indexes; use `_all` or empty string to perform the operation on all indexes.|
|query|query|boolean|false|If `true`, clears the query cache.|
|request|query|boolean|false|If `true`, clears the request cache.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
  "_shards": {
    "failed": 0,

    "failures": [
      {
        "shard": 0,

            {}
          ],

          ],

          },

}
```
