<h3 id="indicesclone1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the source index to clone.|
|target|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|Name of the target index to create.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|task_execution_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Explicit task execution timeout, only useful when `wait_for_completion` is false, defaults to `1h`.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|Should this request wait until the operation has completed before returning.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» aliases|body|object|false|Aliases for the resulting index.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[indices._common___Alias](#schemaindices._common___alias)|false|The index alias configuration.|
|» settings|body|object|false|Configuration options for the target index.|

|shards_acknowledged|boolean|true|none|none|
|index|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|none|none|

<h3 id="indicesclone0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the source index to clone.|
|target|path|[_common___Name](#schema_common___name)|true|Name of the target index to create.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|task_execution_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Explicit task execution timeout, only useful when `wait_for_completion` is false, defaults to `1h`.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|Should this request wait until the operation has completed before returning.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» aliases|body|object|false|Aliases for the resulting index.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[indices._common___Alias](#schemaindices._common___alias)|false|The index alias configuration.|
|» settings|body|object|false|Configuration options for the target index.|

```json
{
  "acknowledged": true,

  "index": "string"
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="indicesclone0-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acknowledged|boolean|true|none|For a successful response, this value is always true. On failure, an exception is returned instead.|
|shards_acknowledged|boolean|true|none|none|
|index|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## indices.close.0

<a id="opIdindices.close.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_close \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /{index}/_close`

Closes an index.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/index-apis/close-index/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesclose0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list or wildcard expression of index names used to limit the request.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="count2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to search.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To search all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: `AND` or `OR`.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|none|
|ignore_throttled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, concrete, expanded or aliased indexes are ignored when frozen.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|lenient|query|boolean|false|If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.|
|min_score|query|number(float)|false|Sets the minimum `_score` value that documents must have to be included in the result.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|q|query|string|false|Query in the Lucene query string syntax.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|terminate_after|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of documents to collect for each shard.<br>If a query reaches this limit, OpenSearch terminates the query early.<br>OpenSearch collects documents before sorting.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|

|default_operator|AND|
|default_operator|or|
|default_operator|OR|

<h3 id="count3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to search.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To search all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: `AND` or `OR`.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|none|
|ignore_throttled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, concrete, expanded or aliased indexes are ignored when frozen.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|lenient|query|boolean|false|If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.|
|min_score|query|number(float)|false|Sets the minimum `_score` value that documents must have to be included in the result.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|q|query|string|false|Query in the Lucene query string syntax.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|terminate_after|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of documents to collect for each shard.<br>If a query reaches this limit, OpenSearch terminates the query early.<br>OpenSearch collects documents before sorting.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

## create.1

<a id="opIdcreate.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_create/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{}'
```

`PUT /{index}/_create/{id}`

Creates a new document in the index.

Returns a 409 response when a document with a same ID already exists in the index.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/document-apis/index-document/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{}
```

<h3 id="create1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|true|The unique identifier for the document.|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the data stream or index to target.<br>If the target doesn't exist and matches the name or wildcard (`*`) pattern of an index template with a `data_stream` definition, this request creates the data stream.<br>If the target doesn't exist and doesn't match a data stream template, this request creates the index.|
|pipeline|query|string|false|ID of the pipeline to use to preprocess incoming documents.<br>If the index has a default ingest pipeline specified, then setting the value to `_none` disables the default ingest pipeline for this request.<br>If a final pipeline is configured it will always run, regardless of the value of this parameter.|
|refresh|query|[_common___Refresh](#schema_common___refresh)|false|If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes the affected shards to make this operation visible to search, if `wait_for` then wait for a refresh to make this operation visible to search, if `false` do nothing with refreshes.<br>Valid values: `true`, `false`, `wait_for`.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period the request waits for the following operations: automatic index creation, dynamic mapping updates, waiting for active shards.|
|version|query|[_common___VersionNumber](#schema_common___versionnumber)|false|Explicit version number for concurrency control.<br>The specified version must match the current version of the document for the request to succeed.|
|version_type|query|[_common___VersionType](#schema_common___versiontype)|false|The specific version type: `external`, `external_gte`.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|

> 201 Response

```json
  "_type": "string",
  "_id": "string",
  "_index": "string",
  "_primary_term": 0,
  "result": "created",
  "_seq_no": 0,

    "failed": 0,
    "successful": 0,
    "total": 0,
    "failures": [
```


<h3 id="deletebyquery0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to search.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To search all data streams or indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|Set to `true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a list of fields to return.|
|_source_excludes|query|[string]|false|List of fields to exclude from the returned `_source` field.|
|_source_includes|query|[string]|false|List of fields to extract and return from the `_source` field.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.<br>For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.|
|conflicts|query|[_common___Conflicts](#schema_common___conflicts)|false|What to do if delete by query hits version conflicts: `abort` or `proceed`.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: `AND` or `OR`.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`. Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|from|query|integer(int32)|false|Starting offset.|

`DELETE /{index}/_doc/{id}`

Removes a document from the index.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/document-apis/delete-document/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="delete0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|true|The unique identifier for the document.|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the target index.|
|if_primary_term|query|integer(int64)|false|Only perform the operation if the document has this primary term.|
|if_seq_no|query|[_common___SequenceNumber](#schema_common___sequencenumber)|false|Only perform the operation if the document has this sequence number.|
|refresh|query|[_common___Refresh](#schema_common___refresh)|false|If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes the affected shards to make this operation visible to search, if `wait_for` then wait for a refresh to make this operation visible to search, if `false` do nothing with refreshes.<br>Valid values: `true`, `false`, `wait_for`.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for active shards.|
|version|query|[_common___VersionNumber](#schema_common___versionnumber)|false|Explicit version number for concurrency control.<br>The specified version must match the current version of the document for the request to succeed.|
|version_type|query|[_common___VersionType](#schema_common___versiontype)|false|The specific version type: `external`, `external_gte`.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|`true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a list of fields to return.|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude in the response.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|realtime|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request is real time as opposed to near real time.|
|refresh|query|[_common___Refresh](#schema_common___refresh)|false|If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes all shards involved in the delete by query after the request completes.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|Target the specified primary shard.|
|stored_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|List of stored fields to return as part of a hit.<br>If no fields are specified, no stored fields are included in the response.<br>If this field is specified, the `_source` parameter defaults to false.|
|version|query|[_common___VersionNumber](#schema_common___versionnumber)|false|Explicit version number for concurrency control.<br>The specified version must match the current version of the document for the request to succeed.|
|version_type|query|[_common___VersionType](#schema_common___versiontype)|false|The specific version type: `external`, `external_gte`.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|true|Defines the document ID.|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Index names used to limit the request.<br>Only a single index name can be provided to this parameter.|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|Set to `true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a list of fields to return.|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude from the response.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: `AND` or `OR`.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.|
|lenient|query|boolean|false|If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|q|query|string|false|Query in the Lucene query string syntax.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|stored_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of stored fields to return in the response.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|

<h3 id="explain1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|true|Defines the document ID.|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Index names used to limit the request.<br>Only a single index name can be provided to this parameter.|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|Set to `true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a list of fields to return.|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude from the response.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: `AND` or `OR`.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.|
|lenient|query|boolean|false|If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|q|query|string|false|Query in the Lucene query string syntax.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|stored_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of stored fields to return in the response.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|default_operator|and|
|default_operator|AND|
|default_operator|or|
|default_operator|OR|

```json
    "description": "string",

      {}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="explain1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_type|[_common___Type](#schema_common___type)|false|none|The type of document or resource.|
|_index|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|none|none|
|_id|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|true|none|The unique identifier for a resource.|
|matched|boolean|true|none|none|
|explanation|[_core.explain___Explanation](#schema_core.explain___explanation)|false|none|none|
|get|object|false|none|none|
|» fields|object|false|none|The fields retrieved from the document.|
|» found|boolean|true|none|Whether the document was found.|
|» _seq_no|[_common___SequenceNumber](#schema_common___sequencenumber)|false|none|The sequence number of the document.|
|» _primary_term|integer(int64)|false|none|The primary term of the document.|
|» _routing|[_common___Routing](#schema_common___routing)|false|none|The routing value for the document.|
|» _source|[_common___TDocument](#schema_common___tdocument)|false|none|The source of the document.|
|» _source|[_common___TDocument](#schema_common___tdocument)|false|none|none|

`GET /{index}/_field_caps`


<h3 id="fieldcaps2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit the request. Supports wildcards (*). To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use * or `_all`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias,<br>or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes. This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes. For example, a request<br>targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with foo but no index starts with bar.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|The type of index that wildcard patterns can match. If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams. Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of fields to retrieve capabilities for. Wildcard (`*`) expressions are supported.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `true`, missing or closed indexes are not included in the response.|
|include_unmapped|query|boolean|false|If `true`, unmapped fields are included in the response.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» fields|body|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or a wildcard expression specifying the fields to include in the statistics.<br>Used as the default list unless a specific field list is provided in the `completion_fields` or `fielddata_fields` parameters.|
|» index_filter|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|

<h3 id="fieldcaps2-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|indices|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|none|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|fields|object|true|none|none|
|» **additionalProperties**|object|false|none|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|[_core.field_caps___FieldCapability](#schema_core.field_caps___fieldcapability)|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication

## indices.flush.2

<a id="opIdindices.flush.2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_flush \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}/_flush`

Performs the flush operation on one or more indexes.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesflush2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to flush.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To flush all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|force|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request forces a flush even if there are no changes to commit to the index.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|wait_if_ongoing|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the flush operation blocks until execution when another flush operation is running.<br>If `false`, OpenSearch returns an error if you request a flush when another flush operation is running.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "_shards": {
    "failed": 0,
    "successful": 0,
    "total": 0,
    "failures": [

        "shard": 0,

        "node": "string",
        "reason": {
          "type": "string",
          "reason": "string",
          "stack_trace": "string",
          "caused_by": {},
          "root_cause": [
            {}
          ],
          "suppressed": [
            {}
          ],
          "header": {
            "property1": "string",
            "property2": "string"
          },
          "property1": null,
          "property2": null
        }
      }
    ],
    "skipped": 0
  }
}
```

`POST /{index}/_forcemerge`

Performs the force merge operation on one or more indexes.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesforcemerge1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of index names; use `_all` or empty string to perform the operation on all indexes|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|Whether to ignore if a wildcard indexes expression resolves into no concrete indexes. (This includes `_all` string or when no indexes have been specified)|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Whether to expand wildcard expression to concrete indexes that are open, closed or both.|
|flush|query|boolean|false|Specify whether the index should be flushed after performing the operation.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|Whether specified concrete indexes should be ignored when unavailable (missing or closed)|
|max_num_segments|query|integer(int64)|false|The number of larger segments into which smaller segments are merged.<br>Set this parameter to 1 to merge all segments into one segment.<br>The default behavior is to perform the merge as necessary.|
|only_expunge_deletes|query|boolean|false|Specify whether the operation should only expunge deleted documents|
|primary_only|query|boolean|false|Specify whether the operation should only perform on primary shards. Defaults to false.|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|Should the request wait until the force merge is completed.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

`GET /{index}/_mget`

Allows to get multiple documents in one request.

```json
    {
      "_id": "string",

      "version": 0,
      "version_type": "external"
    }
  ],
  "ids": "string"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|The name of the index to retrieve documents from when `ids` are specified, or when a document in the `docs` array does not specify an index.|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|Set to `true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a list of fields to return.|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude from the response.<br>You can also use this parameter to exclude fields from the subset specified in `_source_includes` query parameter.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.<br>If this parameter is specified, only these source fields are returned. You can exclude fields from this subset using the `_source_excludes` query parameter.<br>If the `_source` parameter is `false`, this parameter is ignored.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on. Random by default.|
|realtime|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request is real time as opposed to near real time.|
|refresh|query|[_common___Refresh](#schema_common___refresh)|false|If `true`, the request refreshes relevant shards before retrieving documents.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|stored_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|If `true`, retrieves the document fields stored in the index rather than the document `_source`.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|

You can exclude fields from this subset using the `_source_excludes` query parameter.<br>If the `_source` parameter is `false`, this parameter is ignored.|

`GET /{index}/_msearch`

Allows to execute several search operations in one request.

<h3 id="msearch2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and index aliases to search.|
|allow_partial_results|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether to return partial results if there are shard request timeouts or shard failures|
|ccs_minimize_roundtrips|query|boolean|false|If `true`, network round-trips between the coordinating node and remote clusters are minimized for cross-cluster search requests.|

|max_concurrent_shard_requests|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of concurrent shard requests that each sub-search request executes per node.|

This filter roundtrip can limit the number of shards significantly if for instance a shard can not match any documents based on its rewrite method i.e., if date filters are mandatory to match but the shard bounds and the query are disjoint.|

|search_type|query|[_common___SearchType](#schema_common___searchtype)|false|Indicates whether global term and document frequencies should be used when scoring returned documents.|
|typed_keys|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether aggregation and suggester names should be prefixed by their respective types in the response.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|[[_core.msearch___RequestItem](#schema_core.msearch___requestitem)]|true|none|

<h3 id="mtermvectors2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|The name of the index that contains the document.|
|field_statistics|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes the document count, sum of document frequencies, and sum of total term frequencies.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|none|
|ids|query|[[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)]|false|A comma-separated list of documents IDs. You must provide either the `docs` field in the request body or specify `ids` as a query parameter or in the request body.|
|offsets|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes term offsets.|
|payloads|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes term payloads.|
|positions|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes term positions.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard on which the operation should be performed.<br>See [preference query parameter]({{site.url}}{{site.baseurl}}/api-reference/search-apis/search/#the-preference-query-parameter) for a list of available options.<br>By default the requests are routed randomly to available shard copies (primary or replica), with no guarantee of consistency across repeated queries.|
|realtime|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request is real time as opposed to near real time.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|term_statistics|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes term frequency and document frequency.|
|version|query|[_common___VersionNumber](#schema_common___versionnumber)|false|If `true`, returns the document version as part of a hit.|
|version_type|query|[_common___VersionType](#schema_common___versiontype)|false|The specific version type.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» docs|body|[[_core.mtermvectors___Operation](#schema_core.mtermvectors___operation)]|false|Array of existing or artificial documents.|
|» ids|body|[[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)]|false|Simplified syntax to specify documents by their ID if they're in the same index.|

<h3 id="indicesopen0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>By default, you must explicitly name the indexes you using to limit the request.<br>To limit a request using `_all`, `*`, or other wildcard expressions, change the `action.destructive_requires_name` setting to false.<br>You can update this setting in the `opensearch.yml` file or using the cluster update settings API.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|task_execution_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Explicit task execution timeout, only useful when `wait_for_completion` is false, defaults to `1h`.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|Should this request wait until the operation has completed before returning.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="rankeval2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and index aliases used to limit the request. Wildcard (`*`) expressions are supported.<br>To target all data streams and indexes in a cluster, omit this parameter or use `_all` or `*`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes. This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes. For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Whether to expand wildcard expression to concrete indexes that are open, closed or both.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `true`, missing or closed indexes are not included in the response.|
|search_type|query|[_common___SearchType](#schema_common___searchtype)|false|Search operation type|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» requests|body|[[_core.rank_eval___RankEvalRequestItem](#schema_core.rank_eval___rankevalrequestitem)]|true|A set of typical search requests, together with their provided ratings.|
|» metric|body|[_core.rank_eval___RankEvalMetric](#schema_core.rank_eval___rankevalmetric)|false|none|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="rankeval2-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|metric_score|number(double)|true|none|The overall evaluation quality calculated by the defined metric|
|details|object|true|none|The details section contains one entry for every query in the original requests section, keyed by the search request id|
|» **additionalProperties**|[_core.rank_eval___RankEvalMetricDetail](#schema_core.rank_eval___rankevalmetricdetail)|false|none|none|
|failures|object|true|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

`POST /{index}/_rank_eval`

<h3 id="rankeval3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and index aliases used to limit the request. Wildcard (`*`) expressions are supported.<br>To target all data streams and indexes in a cluster, omit this parameter or use `_all` or `*`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes. This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes. For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Whether to expand wildcard expression to concrete indexes that are open, closed or both.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `true`, missing or closed indexes are not included in the response.|
|search_type|query|[_common___SearchType](#schema_common___searchtype)|false|Search operation type|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» requests|body|[[_core.rank_eval___RankEvalRequestItem](#schema_core.rank_eval___rankevalrequestitem)]|true|A set of typical search requests, together with their provided ratings.|
|» metric|body|[_core.rank_eval___RankEvalMetric](#schema_core.rank_eval___rankevalmetric)|false|none|

## indices.refresh.2

<a id="opIdindices.refresh.2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_refresh \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}/_refresh`

Performs the refresh operation in one or more indexes.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/tuning-your-cluster/availability-and-recovery/remote-store/index/#refresh-level-and-request-level-durability">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesrefresh2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit the request.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To target all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "_shards": {
    "failed": 0,
    "successful": 0,
    "total": 0,
    "failures": [
      {
        "shard": 0,
        "index": "string",
        "node": "string",
        "reason": {
          "type": "string",
          "reason": "string",
          "stack_trace": "string",
          "caused_by": {},
          "root_cause": [
            {}
          ],
          "suppressed": [
            {}
          ],
          "header": {
            "property1": "string",
            "property2": "string"
          },
          "property1": null,
          "property2": null
        }
      }
    ],
    "skipped": 0
  }
}
```

<h3 id="indicesrefresh2-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[_common___ShardsOperationResponseBase](#schema_common___shardsoperationresponsebase)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h3 id="search2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to search.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To search all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|Indicates which source fields are returned for matching documents.<br>These fields are returned in the `hits._source` property of the search response.<br>Valid values are:<br>`true` to return the entire document source;<br>`false` to not return the document source;<br>`<string>` to return the source fields that are specified as a comma-separated list (supports wildcard (`*`) patterns).|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude from the response.<br>You can also use this parameter to exclude fields from the subset specified in `_source_includes` query parameter.<br>If the `_source` parameter is `false`, this parameter is ignored.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.<br>If this parameter is specified, only these source fields are returned.<br>You can exclude fields from this subset using the `_source_excludes` query parameter.<br>If the `_source` parameter is `false`, this parameter is ignored.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.<br>For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|allow_partial_search_results|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns partial results if there are shard request timeouts or shard failures. If `false`, returns an error with no partial results.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.<br>This parameter can only be used when the q query string parameter is specified.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the q query string parameter is specified.|
|batched_reduce_size|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of shard results that should be reduced at once on the coordinating node.<br>This value should be used as a protection mechanism to reduce the memory overhead per search request if the potential number of shards in the request can be large.|
|cancel_after_time_interval|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The time after which the search request will be canceled.<br>Request-level parameter takes precedence over `cancel_after_time_interval` cluster setting.|
|ccs_minimize_roundtrips|query|boolean|false|If `true`, network round-trips between the coordinating node and the remote clusters are minimized when executing cross-cluster search (CCS) requests.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: AND or OR.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the q query string parameter is specified.|
|docvalue_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of fields to return as the docvalue representation for each hit.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.|
|explain|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns detailed information about score computation as part of a hit.|
|from|query|integer(int32)|false|Starting document offset.<br>Needs to be non-negative.<br>By default, you cannot page through more than 10,000 hits using the `from` and `size` parameters.<br>To page through more hits, use the `search_after` parameter.|
|ignore_throttled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, concrete, expanded or aliased indexes will be ignored when frozen.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|include_named_queries_score|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether `hit.matched_queries` should be rendered as a map that includes the name of the matched query associated with its score (true) or as an array containing the name of the matched queries (false)|
|index|query|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|false|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to search.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To search all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|lenient|query|boolean|false|If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|max_concurrent_shard_requests|query|integer(int32)|false|Defines the number of concurrent shard requests per node this search executes concurrently.<br>This value should be used to limit the impact of the search on the cluster in order to limit the number of concurrent shard requests.|
|phase_took|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether to return phase-level `took` time values in the response.|
|pre_filter_shard_size|query|integer(int32)|false|Defines a threshold that enforces a pre-filter roundtrip to prefilter search shards based on query rewriting if the number of shards the search request expands to exceeds the threshold.<br>This filter roundtrip can limit the number of shards significantly if for instance a shard can not match any documents based on its rewrite method (if date filters are mandatory to match but the shard bounds and the query are disjoint).<br>When unspecified, the pre-filter phase is executed if any of these conditions is met:<br>the request targets more than 128 shards;<br>the request targets one or more read-only index;<br>the primary sort of the query targets an indexed field.|
|preference|query|string|false|Nodes and shards used for the search.<br>By default, OpenSearch selects from eligible nodes and shards using adaptive replica selection, accounting for allocation awareness. Valid values are:<br>`_only_local` to run the search only on shards on the local node;<br>`_local` to, if possible, run the search on shards on the local node, or if not, select shards using the default method;<br>`_only_nodes:<node-id>,<node-id>` to run the search on only the specified nodes IDs, where, if suitable shards exist on more than one selected node, use shards on those nodes using the default method, or if none of the specified nodes are available, select shards from any available node using the default method;<br>`_prefer_nodes:<node-id>,<node-id>` to if possible, run the search on the specified nodes IDs, or if not, select shards using the default method;<br>`_shards:<shard>,<shard>` to run the search only on the specified shards;<br>`<custom-string>` (any string that does not start with `_`) to route searches with the same `<custom-string>` to the same shards in the same order.|
|q|query|string|false|Query in the Lucene query string syntax using query parameter search.<br>Query parameter searches do not support the full OpenSearch Query DSL but are handy for testing.|
|request_cache|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the caching of search results is enabled for requests where `size` is `0`.<br>Defaults to index level settings.|
|rest_total_hits_as_int|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether `hits.total` should be rendered as an integer or an object in the rest search response.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|scroll|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to retain the search context for scrolling. See Scroll search results.<br>By default, this value cannot exceed `1d` (24 hours).<br>You can change this limit using the `search.max_keep_alive` cluster-level setting.|
|search_pipeline|query|string|false|Customizable sequence of processing stages applied to search queries.|
|search_type|query|[_common___SearchType](#schema_common___searchtype)|false|How distributed term frequencies are calculated for relevance scoring.|
|seq_no_primary_term|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns sequence number and primary term of the last modification of each hit.|
|size|query|integer(int32)|false|Defines the number of hits to return.<br>By default, you cannot page through more than 10,000 hits using the `from` and `size` parameters.<br>To page through more hits, use the `search_after` parameter.|
|sort|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of <field>:<direction> pairs.|
|stats|query|[string]|false|Specific `tag` of the request for logging and statistical purposes.|
|stored_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of stored fields to return as part of a hit.<br>If no fields are specified, no stored fields are included in the response.<br>If this field is specified, the `_source` parameter defaults to `false`.<br>You can pass `_source: true` to return both source fields and stored fields in the search response.|
|suggest_field|query|[_common___Field](#schema_common___field)|false|Specifies which field to use for suggestions.|
|suggest_mode|query|[_common___SuggestMode](#schema_common___suggestmode)|false|Specifies the suggest mode.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `suggest_field` and `suggest_text` query string parameters are specified.|
|suggest_size|query|integer(int32)|false|Number of suggestions to return.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `suggest_field` and `suggest_text` query string parameters are specified.|
|suggest_text|query|string|false|The source text for which the suggestions should be returned.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `suggest_field` and `suggest_text` query string parameters are specified.|
|terminate_after|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of documents to collect for each shard.<br>If a query reaches this limit, OpenSearch terminates the query early.<br>OpenSearch collects documents before sorting.<br>Use with caution.<br>OpenSearch applies this parameter to each shard handling the request.<br>When possible, let OpenSearch perform early termination automatically.<br>Avoid specifying this parameter for requests that target data streams with backing indexes across multiple data tiers.<br>If set to `0` (default), the query does not terminate early.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Specifies the period of time to wait for a response from each shard.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|track_scores|query|boolean|false|If `true`, calculate and return document scores, even if the scores are not used for sorting.|
|track_total_hits|query|[_core.search___TrackHits](#schema_core.search___trackhits)|false|Number of hits matching the query to count accurately.<br>If `true`, the exact number of hits is returned at the cost of some performance.<br>If `false`, the response does not include the total number of hits matching the query.|
|typed_keys|query|boolean|false|If `true`, aggregation and suggester names are be prefixed by their respective types in the response.|
|verbose_pipeline|query|boolean|false|Enables or disables verbose mode for the search pipeline.<br>When verbose mode is enabled, detailed information about each processor<br>in the search pipeline is included in the search response. This includes<br>the processor name, execution status, input, output, and time taken for processing.<br>This parameter is primarily intended for debugging purposes, allowing users<br>to track how data flows and transforms through the search pipeline.|
|version|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns document version as part of a hit.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
