<h3 id="search3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to search.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To search all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|Indicates which source fields are returned for matching documents.<br>These fields are returned in the `hits._source` property of the search response.<br>Valid values are:<br>`true` to return the entire document source;<br>`false` to not return the document source;<br>`<string>` to return the source fields that are specified as a comma-separated list (supports wildcard (`*`) patterns).|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude from the response.<br>You can also use this parameter to exclude fields from the subset specified in `_source_includes` query parameter.<br>If the `_source` parameter is `false`, this parameter is ignored.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.<br>If this parameter is specified, only these source fields are returned.<br>You can exclude fields from this subset using the `_source_excludes` query parameter.<br>If the `_source` parameter is `false`, this parameter is ignored.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.<br>For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|allow_partial_search_results|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns partial results if there are shard request timeouts or shard failures. If `false`, returns an error with no partial results.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.<br>This parameter can only be used when the q query string parameter is specified.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the q query string parameter is specified.|
|batched_reduce_size|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of shard results that should be reduced at once on the coordinating node.<br>This value should be used as a protection mechanism to reduce the memory overhead per search request if the potential number of shards in the request can be large.|
|cancel_after_time_interval|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|The time after which the search request will be canceled.<br>Request-level parameter takes precedence over `cancel_after_time_interval` cluster setting.|
|ccs_minimize_roundtrips|query|boolean|false|If `true`, network round-trips between the coordinating node and the remote clusters are minimized when executing cross-cluster search (CCS) requests.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: AND or OR.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the q query string parameter is specified.|
|docvalue_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of fields to return as the docvalue representation for each hit.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.|
|explain|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns detailed information about score computation as part of a hit.|
|from|query|integer(int32)|false|Starting document offset.<br>Needs to be non-negative.<br>By default, you cannot page through more than 10,000 hits using the `from` and `size` parameters.<br>To page through more hits, use the `search_after` parameter.|
|ignore_throttled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, concrete, expanded or aliased indexes will be ignored when frozen.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|include_named_queries_score|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether `hit.matched_queries` should be rendered as a map that includes the name of the matched query associated with its score (true) or as an array containing the name of the matched queries (false)|
|index|query|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|false|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to search.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To search all data streams and indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|lenient|query|boolean|false|If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|max_concurrent_shard_requests|query|integer(int32)|false|Defines the number of concurrent shard requests per node this search executes concurrently.<br>This value should be used to limit the impact of the search on the cluster in order to limit the number of concurrent shard requests.|
|phase_took|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether to return phase-level `took` time values in the response.|
|pre_filter_shard_size|query|integer(int32)|false|Defines a threshold that enforces a pre-filter roundtrip to prefilter search shards based on query rewriting if the number of shards the search request expands to exceeds the threshold.<br>This filter roundtrip can limit the number of shards significantly if for instance a shard can not match any documents based on its rewrite method (if date filters are mandatory to match but the shard bounds and the query are disjoint).<br>When unspecified, the pre-filter phase is executed if any of these conditions is met:<br>the request targets more than 128 shards;<br>the request targets one or more read-only index;<br>the primary sort of the query targets an indexed field.|
|preference|query|string|false|Nodes and shards used for the search.<br>By default, OpenSearch selects from eligible nodes and shards using adaptive replica selection, accounting for allocation awareness. Valid values are:<br>`_only_local` to run the search only on shards on the local node;<br>`_local` to, if possible, run the search on shards on the local node, or if not, select shards using the default method;<br>`_only_nodes:<node-id>,<node-id>` to run the search on only the specified nodes IDs, where, if suitable shards exist on more than one selected node, use shards on those nodes using the default method, or if none of the specified nodes are available, select shards from any available node using the default method;<br>`_prefer_nodes:<node-id>,<node-id>` to if possible, run the search on the specified nodes IDs, or if not, select shards using the default method;<br>`_shards:<shard>,<shard>` to run the search only on the specified shards;<br>`<custom-string>` (any string that does not start with `_`) to route searches with the same `<custom-string>` to the same shards in the same order.|
|q|query|string|false|Query in the Lucene query string syntax using query parameter search.<br>Query parameter searches do not support the full OpenSearch Query DSL but are handy for testing.|
|request_cache|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the caching of search results is enabled for requests where `size` is `0`.<br>Defaults to index level settings.|
|rest_total_hits_as_int|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether `hits.total` should be rendered as an integer or an object in the rest search response.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|scroll|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to retain the search context for scrolling. See Scroll search results.<br>By default, this value cannot exceed `1d` (24 hours).<br>You can change this limit using the `search.max_keep_alive` cluster-level setting.|
|search_pipeline|query|string|false|Customizable sequence of processing stages applied to search queries.|
|search_type|query|[_common___SearchType](#schema_common___searchtype)|false|How distributed term frequencies are calculated for relevance scoring.|
|seq_no_primary_term|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns sequence number and primary term of the last modification of each hit.|
|size|query|integer(int32)|false|Defines the number of hits to return.<br>By default, you cannot page through more than 10,000 hits using the `from` and `size` parameters.<br>To page through more hits, use the `search_after` parameter.|
|sort|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of <field>:<direction> pairs.|
|stats|query|[string]|false|Specific `tag` of the request for logging and statistical purposes.|
|stored_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of stored fields to return as part of a hit.<br>If no fields are specified, no stored fields are included in the response.<br>If this field is specified, the `_source` parameter defaults to `false`.<br>You can pass `_source: true` to return both source fields and stored fields in the search response.|
|suggest_field|query|[_common___Field](#schema_common___field)|false|Specifies which field to use for suggestions.|
|suggest_mode|query|[_common___SuggestMode](#schema_common___suggestmode)|false|Specifies the suggest mode.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `suggest_field` and `suggest_text` query string parameters are specified.|
|suggest_size|query|integer(int32)|false|Number of suggestions to return.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `suggest_field` and `suggest_text` query string parameters are specified.|
|suggest_text|query|string|false|The source text for which the suggestions should be returned.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `suggest_field` and `suggest_text` query string parameters are specified.|
|terminate_after|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of documents to collect for each shard.<br>If a query reaches this limit, OpenSearch terminates the query early.<br>OpenSearch collects documents before sorting.<br>Use with caution.<br>OpenSearch applies this parameter to each shard handling the request.<br>When possible, let OpenSearch perform early termination automatically.<br>Avoid specifying this parameter for requests that target data streams with backing indexes across multiple data tiers.<br>If set to `0` (default), the query does not terminate early.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Specifies the period of time to wait for a response from each shard.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|track_scores|query|boolean|false|If `true`, calculate and return document scores, even if the scores are not used for sorting.|
|track_total_hits|query|[_core.search___TrackHits](#schema_core.search___trackhits)|false|Number of hits matching the query to count accurately.<br>If `true`, the exact number of hits is returned at the cost of some performance.<br>If `false`, the response does not include the total number of hits matching the query.|
|typed_keys|query|boolean|false|If `true`, aggregation and suggester names are be prefixed by their respective types in the response.|
|verbose_pipeline|query|boolean|false|Enables or disables verbose mode for the search pipeline.<br>When verbose mode is enabled, detailed information about each processor<br>in the search pipeline is included in the search response. This includes<br>the processor name, execution status, input, output, and time taken for processing.<br>This parameter is primarily intended for debugging purposes, allowing users<br>to track how data flows and transforms through the search pipeline.|

## search_shards.2

<a id="opIdsearch_shards.2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_search_shards \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "slice": {
      "field": "string",
      "id": 0,
      "max": 0
    }
  }'
```

`GET /{index}/_search_shards`

Returns information about the indexes and shards that a search request would be executed against.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "slice": {
    "field": "string",
    "id": 0,
    "max": 0
  }
}
```

<h3 id="searchshards2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|Returns the indexes and shards that a search request would be executed against.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.<br>For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» slice|body|[_common___SlicedScroll](#schema_common___slicedscroll)|false|The configuration for a sliced scroll request.|

## search_shards.3

<a id="opIdsearch_shards.3"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_search_shards \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "slice": {
      "field": "string",
      "id": 0,
      "max": 0
    }
  }'
```

`POST /{index}/_search_shards`

Returns information about the indexes and shards that a search request would be executed against.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "slice": {
    "field": "string",
    "id": 0,
    "max": 0
  }
}
```

<h3 id="searchshards3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|Returns the indexes and shards that a search request would be executed against.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.<br>For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» slice|body|[_common___SlicedScroll](#schema_common___slicedscroll)|false|The configuration for a sliced scroll request.|

## create_pit.0

<a id="opIdcreate_pit.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_search/point_in_time \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /{index}/_search/point_in_time`

Creates point in time context.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/search-plugins/point-in-time-api/#create-a-pit">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="createpit0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[string]|true|A comma-separated list of indexes; use `_all` or empty string to perform the operation on all indexes.|
|allow_partial_pit_creation|query|boolean|false|Allow if point in time can be created with partial failures.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Whether to expand wildcard expression to concrete indexes that are open, closed or both.|
|keep_alive|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Specify the keep alive for point in time.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specify the node or shard the operation should be performed on.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of specific routing values.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "pit_id": "string",
  "_shards": {
    "failed": 0,

    "total": 0,
    "failures": [
      {
        "shard": 0,
        "index": "string",
        "node": "string",
        "reason": {
          "type": "string",
          "reason": "string",
          "stack_trace": "string",
          "caused_by": {},
          "root_cause": [
            {}
          ],
          "suppressed": [
            {}
          ],
          "header": {
            "property1": "string",
            "property2": "string"
          },
          "property1": null,
          "property2": null
        }
      }
    ],
    "skipped": 0
  },
  "creation_time": 0
}
```

|200|OK||Inline|

## search_template.2

<a id="opIdsearch_template.2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_search/template \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "explain": true,
    "id": "string",
    "params": {},
    "profile": true,
    "source": "string"
  }'
```

`GET /{index}/_search/template`

Allows to use the Mustache language to pre-render a search definition.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/search-plugins/search-template/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "explain": true,
  "id": "string",
  "params": {},
  "profile": true,
  "source": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="searchtemplate2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes,<br>and aliases to search. Supports wildcards (*).|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.<br>For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|ccs_minimize_roundtrips|query|boolean|false|If `true`, network round-trips are minimized for cross-cluster search requests.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|explain|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes additional details about score computation as part of a hit.|
|ignore_throttled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, specified concrete, expanded, or aliased indexes are not included in the response when throttled.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|phase_took|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether to return phase-level `took` time values in the response.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|profile|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the query execution is profiled.|
|rest_total_hits_as_int|query|boolean|false|If `true`, `hits.total` are rendered as an integer in the response.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|scroll|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Specifies how long a consistent view of the index<br>should be maintained for scrolled search.|
|search_pipeline|query|string|false|Customizable sequence of processing stages applied to search queries.|
|search_type|query|[_common___SearchType](#schema_common___searchtype)|false|The type of the search operation.|
|typed_keys|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response prefixes aggregation and suggester names with their respective types.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» explain|body|boolean|false|If `true`, returns detailed information about score calculation as part of each hit.|
|» id|body|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|false|The unique identifier for a resource.|
|» params|body|object|false|Key-value pairs used to replace Mustache variables in the template.<br>The key is the variable name.<br>The value is the variable value.|
|» profile|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the query execution is profiled.|
|» source|body|string|false|An inline search template. Supports the same parameters as the search API<br>request body. Also supports Mustache variables. If no id is specified, this<br>parameter is required.|

## search_template.3

<a id="opIdsearch_template.3"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_search/template \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "explain": true,
    "id": "string",
    "params": {},
    "profile": true,
    "source": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /{index}/_search/template`

Allows to use the Mustache language to pre-render a search definition.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/search-plugins/search-template/">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "explain": true,
  "id": "string",
  "params": {},
  "profile": true,
  "source": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="searchtemplate3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes,<br>and aliases to search. Supports wildcards (*).|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.<br>For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|ccs_minimize_roundtrips|query|boolean|false|If `true`, network round-trips are minimized for cross-cluster search requests.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|explain|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes additional details about score computation as part of a hit.|
|ignore_throttled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, specified concrete, expanded, or aliased indexes are not included in the response when throttled.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|phase_took|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether to return phase-level `took` time values in the response.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|profile|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the query execution is profiled.|
|rest_total_hits_as_int|query|boolean|false|If `true`, `hits.total` are rendered as an integer in the response.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|scroll|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Specifies how long a consistent view of the index<br>should be maintained for scrolled search.|
|search_pipeline|query|string|false|Customizable sequence of processing stages applied to search queries.|
|search_type|query|[_common___SearchType](#schema_common___searchtype)|false|The type of the search operation.|
|typed_keys|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response prefixes aggregation and suggester names with their respective types.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» explain|body|boolean|false|If `true`, returns detailed information about score calculation as part of each hit.|
|» id|body|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|false|The unique identifier for a resource.|
|» params|body|object|false|Key-value pairs used to replace Mustache variables in the template.<br>The key is the variable name.<br>The value is the variable value.|
|» profile|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the query execution is profiled.|
|» source|body|string|false|An inline search template. Supports the same parameters as the search API<br>request body. Also supports Mustache variables. If no id is specified, this<br>parameter is required.|

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|verbose|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request returns a verbose response.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit<br>the request. Supports wildcards (`*`). To target all data streams and<br>indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index<br>alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes. This<br>behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes. For<br>example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index<br>starts with foo but no index starts with `bar`.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.|
|flat_settings|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns settings in flat format.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|include_defaults|query|boolean|false|If `true`, return all default settings in the response.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only. If<br>`false`, information is retrieved from the cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node. If no response is<br>received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an<br>error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="indicesputsettings1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit<br>the request. Supports wildcards (`*`). To target all data streams and<br>indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index<br>alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes. This<br>behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes. For<br>example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index<br>starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match. If the request can target<br>data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match<br>hidden data streams. Supports comma-separated values, such as<br>`open,hidden`.|
|flat_settings|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns settings in flat format.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|Whether specified concrete indexes should be ignored when unavailable (missing or closed).|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node. If no response is<br>received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an<br>error.|
|preserve_existing|query|boolean|false|If `true`, existing index settings remain unchanged.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response. If no response is received before the<br> timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|[indices._common___IndexSettings](#schemaindices._common___indexsettings)|true|none|
|» index|body|[indices._common___IndexSettings](#schemaindices._common___indexsettings)|false|The configuration settings for an index.|
|» mode|body|string|false|none|
|» routing_path|body|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|none|
|» soft_deletes|body|[indices._common___SoftDeletes](#schemaindices._common___softdeletes)|false|The configuration for soft deletes.|
|» soft_deletes.retention_lease.period|body|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|A duration. Units can be `nanos`, `micros`, `ms` (milliseconds), `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), `h` (hours) and `d` (days). Also accepts `0` without a unit and `-1` to indicate an unspecified value.|
|» sort|body|[indices._common___IndexSegmentSort](#schemaindices._common___indexsegmentsort)|false|The configuration for segment sorting.|
|» number_of_shards|body|[_common___StringifiedInteger](#schema_common___stringifiedinteger)|false|Certain APIs may return values, including numbers such as epoch timestamps, as strings. This setting captures<br>this behavior while keeping the semantics of the field type.<br><br>Depending on the target language, code generators can keep the union or remove it and leniently parse<br>strings to the target type.|
|» number_of_replicas|body|[_common___StringifiedInteger](#schema_common___stringifiedinteger)|false|Certain APIs may return values, including numbers such as epoch timestamps, as strings. This setting captures<br>this behavior while keeping the semantics of the field type.<br><br>Depending on the target language, code generators can keep the union or remove it and leniently parse<br>strings to the target type.|
|» number_of_routing_shards|body|[_common___StringifiedInteger](#schema_common___stringifiedinteger)|false|Certain APIs may return values, including numbers such as epoch timestamps, as strings. This setting captures<br>this behavior while keeping the semantics of the field type.<br><br>Depending on the target language, code generators can keep the union or remove it and leniently parse<br>strings to the target type.|
|» check_on_startup|body|[indices._common___IndexCheckOnStartup](#schemaindices._common___indexcheckonstartup)|false|The type of check to perform when starting an index.|
|» codec|body|string|false|The compression type for stored data.|
|» routing_partition_size|body|[_common___StringifiedInteger](#schema_common___stringifiedinteger)|false|Certain APIs may return values, including numbers such as epoch timestamps, as strings. ## indices.get_settings.3

<a id="opIdindices.get_settings.3"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_settings/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}/_settings/{name}`

Returns settings for one or more indexes.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/index-apis/get-settings/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesgetsettings3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases used to limit<br>the request. Supports wildcards (`*`). To target all data streams and<br>indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|name|path|[_common___Names](#schema_common___names)|true|A comma-separated list or wildcard expression of settings to retrieve.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index<br>alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes. This<br>behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes. For<br>example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index<br>starts with foo but no index starts with `bar`.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.|
|flat_settings|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns settings in flat format.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|include_defaults|query|boolean|false|If `true`, return all default settings in the response.|
|local|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request retrieves information from the local node only. If<br>`false`, information is retrieved from the cluster-manager node.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node. If no response is<br>received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an<br>error.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

## indices.shard_stores.1

<a id="opIdindices.shard_stores.1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_shard_stores \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}/_shard_stores`

Provides store information for shard copies of indexes.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesshardstores1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|Limits health reporting to a specific source. Can be a single source or a comma-separated list of sources (comprised of data streams, indexes, and aliases).|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all`<br>value targets only missing or closed indexes. This behavior applies even if the request<br>targets other open indexes.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match. If the request can target data streams,<br>this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `true`, missing or closed indexes are not included in the response.|
|status|query|[indices.shard_stores___ShardStoreStatus](#schemaindices.shard_stores___shardstorestatus) \| [[indices.shard_stores___ShardStoreStatus](#schemaindices.shard_stores___shardstorestatus)]|false|A list of shard health statuses used to limit the request.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|


<h3 id="indicesshrink1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the source index to shrink.|
|target|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the target index to create.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|copy_settings|query|boolean|false|whether or not to copy settings from the source index.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|task_execution_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Explicit task execution timeout, only useful when `wait_for_completion` is false, defaults to `1h`.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|Should this request wait until the operation has completed before returning.|

|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

## get_source.0

<a id="opIdget_source.0"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_source/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}/_source/{id}`

Returns the source of a document.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/document-apis/get-documents/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="getsource0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|true|The unique identifier of the document.|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|The name of the index containing the document.|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|Set to `true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a list of fields to return.|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude in the response.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on. Random by default.|
|realtime|query|boolean|false|Boolean) If `true`, the request is real time as opposed to near real time.|
|refresh|query|[_common___Refresh](#schema_common___refresh)|false|If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes the affected shards to make this operation visible to search. If `false`, do nothing with refreshes.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|Target the specified primary shard.|
|version|query|[_common___VersionNumber](#schema_common___versionnumber)|false|Explicit version number for concurrency control. The specified version must match the current version of the document for the request to succeed.|
|version_type|query|[_common___VersionType](#schema_common___versiontype)|false|The specific version type. One of `internal`, `external`, `external_gte`.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|


```json
    ],

      {}
    ],

      "property1": "string",

}
```

|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|`true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a list of fields to return.|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude in the response.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.|
|preference|query|string|false|Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.<br>Random by default.|
|realtime|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the request is real time as opposed to near real time.|
|refresh|query|[_common___Refresh](#schema_common___refresh)|false|If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes all shards involved in the delete by query after the request completes.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|Target the specified primary shard.|
|version|query|[_common___VersionNumber](#schema_common___versionnumber)|false|Explicit version number for concurrency control.<br>The specified version must match the current version of the document for the request to succeed.|
|version_type|query|[_common___VersionType](#schema_common___versiontype)|false|The specific version type: `external`, `external_gte`.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

<h3 id="indicessplit1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the source index to split.|
|target|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the target index to create.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|copy_settings|query|boolean|false|whether or not to copy settings from the source index.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|task_execution_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Explicit task execution timeout, only useful when `wait_for_completion` is false, defaults to `1h`.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|Should this request wait until the operation has completed before returning.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» aliases|body|object|false|Aliases for the resulting index.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[indices._common___Alias](#schemaindices._common___alias)|false|The index alias configuration.|
|» settings|body|object|false|Configuration options for the target index.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "acknowledged": true,
  "shards_acknowledged": true,
  "index": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="indicessplit1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="indicessplit1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acknowledged|boolean|true|none|For a successful response, this value is always true. On failure, an exception is returned instead.|
|shards_acknowledged|boolean|true|none|none|
|index|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h3 id="indicessplit0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the source index to split.|
|target|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|Name of the target index to create.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Operation timeout for connection to cluster-manager node.|
|copy_settings|query|boolean|false|whether or not to copy settings from the source index.|
|master_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|**Deprecated.** Period to wait for a connection to the cluster-manager node.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|task_execution_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Explicit task execution timeout, only useful when `wait_for_completion` is false, defaults to `1h`.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for a response.<br>If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operation.<br>Set to `all` or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index (`number_of_replicas+1`).|
|wait_for_completion|query|boolean|false|Should this request wait until the operation has completed before returning.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» aliases|body|object|false|Aliases for the resulting index.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[indices._common___Alias](#schemaindices._common___alias)|false|The index alias configuration.|
|» settings|body|object|false|Configuration options for the target index.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="indicessplit0-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acknowledged|boolean|true|none|For a successful response, this value is always true. On failure, an exception is returned instead.|
|shards_acknowledged|boolean|true|none|none|
|index|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## indices.stats.2

<a id="opIdindices.stats.2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_stats \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}/_stats`

Provides statistics on operations happening in an index.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesstats2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of index names; use `_all` or empty string to perform the operation on all indexes|
|completion_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data and suggest statistics.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match. If the request can target data streams, this argument<br>determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams. Supports comma-separated values,<br>such as `open,hidden`.|
|fielddata_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data statistics.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.|
|forbid_closed_indices|query|boolean|false|If `true`, statistics are not collected from closed indexes.|
|groups|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.|
|include_segment_file_sizes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the call reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).|
|include_unloaded_segments|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes information from segments that are not loaded into memory.|
|level|query|[_common___Level](#schema_common___level)|false|Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the cluster, index, or shard level.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|level|cluster|
|level|indices|
|level|shards|

<h3 id="indicesstats2-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="indicesstats2-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_shards|[_common___ShardStatistics](#schema_common___shardstatistics)|true|none|none|
|_all|[indices.stats___AllIndicesStats](#schemaindices.stats___allindicesstats)|true|none|The statistics for all indexes.|
|indices|object|false|none|none|
|» **additionalProperties**|[indices.stats___IndicesStats](#schemaindices.stats___indicesstats)|false|none|The statistics for specific indexes.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## indices.stats.3

<a id="opIdindices.stats.3"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/_stats/_all \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /{index}/_stats/{metric}`

Provides statistics on operations happening in an index.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="indicesstats3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of index names; use `_all` or empty string to perform the operation on all indexes|
|metric|path|[indices.stats___Metric](#schemaindices.stats___metric) \| [[indices.stats___Metric](#schemaindices.stats___metric)]|true|Limit the information returned the specific metrics.|
|completion_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data and suggest statistics.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match. If the request can target data streams, this argument<br>determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams. Supports comma-separated values,<br>such as `open,hidden`.|
|fielddata_fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in field data statistics.|
|fields|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|A comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.|
|forbid_closed_indices|query|boolean|false|If `true`, statistics are not collected from closed indexes.|
|groups|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.|
|include_segment_file_sizes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the call reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).|
|include_unloaded_segments|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response includes information from segments that are not loaded into memory.|
|level|query|[_common___Level](#schema_common___level)|false|Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the cluster, index, or shard level.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|level|cluster|
|level|indices|
|level|shards|

`POST /{index}/_update_by_query`

Performs an update on every document in the index without changing the source,
for example to pick up a mapping change.

`POST /{index}/_update/{id}`

Updates a document with a script or partial document.

<a href="https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/document-apis/update-document/">External documentation</a>

```json

  "detect_noop": true,
  "doc": {},

  "scripted_upsert": true,
  "_source": true,
  "upsert": {}
}
```

<h3 id="update0-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|[_common___Id](#schema_common___id)|true|Document ID|
|index|path|[_common___IndexName](#schema_common___indexname)|true|The name of the index|
|_source|query|[_core.search___SourceConfigParam](#schema_core.search___sourceconfigparam)|false|Set to `false` to disable source retrieval. You can also specify a comma-separated<br>list of the fields you want to retrieve.|
|_source_excludes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|Specify the source fields you want to exclude.|
|_source_includes|query|[_common___Fields](#schema_common___fields)|false|Specify the source fields you want to retrieve.|
|if_primary_term|query|integer(int64)|false|Only perform the operation if the document has this primary term.|
|if_seq_no|query|[_common___SequenceNumber](#schema_common___sequencenumber)|false|Only perform the operation if the document has this sequence number.|
|lang|query|string|false|The script language.|
|refresh|query|[_common___Refresh](#schema_common___refresh)|false|If 'true', OpenSearch refreshes the affected shards to make this operation<br>visible to search, if `wait_for` then wait for a refresh to make this operation<br>visible to search, if `false` do nothing with refreshes.|
|require_alias|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the destination must be an index alias.|
|retry_on_conflict|query|integer(int32)|false|Specify how many times should the operation be retried when a conflict occurs.|
|routing|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Period to wait for dynamic mapping updates and active shards.<br>This guarantees OpenSearch waits for at least the timeout before failing.<br>The actual wait time could be longer, particularly when multiple waits occur.|
|wait_for_active_shards|query|[_common___WaitForActiveShards](#schema_common___waitforactiveshards)|false|The number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the operations.<br>Set to 'all' or any positive integer up to the total number of shards in the index<br>(number_of_replicas+1). Defaults to 1 meaning the primary shard.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» detect_noop|body|boolean|false|Set to `false` to disable setting `result` in the response<br>to `noop` if no change to the document occurred.|
|» doc|body|object|false|A partial update to an existing document.|
|» doc_as_upsert|body|boolean|false|Set to `true` to use the contents of 'doc' as the value of 'upsert'|
|» script|body|[_common___Script](#schema_common___script)|false|none|
|» scripted_upsert|body|boolean|false|Set to `true` to execute the script whether or not the document exists.|
|» _source|body|[_core.search___SourceConfig](#schema_core.search___sourceconfig)|false|Defines how to fetch a source. Fetching can be disabled entirely, or the source can be filtered.|
|» upsert|body|object|false|If the document does not already exist, the contents of 'upsert' are inserted as a<br>new document. If the document exists, the 'script' is executed.|

`GET /{index}/_validate/query`

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to search.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To search all data streams or indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|all_shards|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the validation is executed on all shards instead of one random shard per index.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: `AND` or `OR`.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|explain|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns detailed information if an error has occurred.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|lenient|query|boolean|false|If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.|
|q|query|string|false|Query in the Lucene query string syntax.|
|rewrite|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns a more detailed explanation showing the actual Lucene query that will be executed.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|

|Parameter|Value|

|default_operator|and|
|default_operator|AND|
|default_operator|or|
|default_operator|OR|

<h3 id="indicesvalidatequery3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|[_common___Indices](#schema_common___indices)|true|A comma-separated list of data streams, indexes, and aliases to search.<br>Supports wildcards (`*`).<br>To search all data streams or indexes, omit this parameter or use `*` or `_all`.|
|all_shards|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the validation is executed on all shards instead of one random shard per index.|
|allow_no_indices|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.<br>This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.|
|analyze_wildcard|query|boolean|false|If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.|
|analyzer|query|string|false|Analyzer to use for the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|default_operator|query|[_common.query_dsl___Operator](#schema_common.query_dsl___operator)|false|The default operator for query string query: `AND` or `OR`.|
|df|query|string|false|Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.<br>This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.|
|expand_wildcards|query|[_common___ExpandWildcards](#schema_common___expandwildcards)|false|Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.<br>If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.<br>Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.<br>Valid values are: `all`, `open`, `closed`, `hidden`, `none`.|
|explain|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns detailed information if an error has occurred.|
|ignore_unavailable|query|boolean|false|If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.|
|lenient|query|boolean|false|If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.|
|q|query|string|false|Query in the Lucene query string syntax.|
|rewrite|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns a more detailed explanation showing the actual Lucene query that will be executed.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» query|body|[_common.query_dsl___QueryContainer](#schema_common.query_dsl___querycontainer)|false|none|

## Pause streaming ingestion for the given index.

```bash
curl http://localhost:9200/string/ingestion/_pause \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /{index}/ingestion/_pause`

Use this API to pause ingestion for a given index.

<a href="https://docs.opensearch.org/docs/latest/api-reference/document-apis/pull-based-ingestion-management/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="pause-streaming-ingestion-for-the-given-index-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|path|string|true|Index for which ingestion should be paused.|
|cluster_manager_timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Time to wait for cluster manager connection.|
|timeout|query|[_common___Duration](#schema_common___duration)|false|Timeout for the request.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "acknowledged": true,
  "shards_acknowledged": true,
  "failures": [
    {
      "shard": 0,
      "error": "string"
    }
  ],
  "error": "string"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|

<h3 id="asynchronoussearchsearch0superseded-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|index|query|string|false|The name of the index to be searched. Can be an individual name, a comma-separated list of indexes, or a wildcard expression of index names.|
|keep_alive|query|string|false|The amount of time that the result is saved in the cluster. For example, `2d` means that the results are stored in the cluster for 48 hours. <br>The saved search results are deleted after this period or if the search is canceled. Note that this includes the query execution time. <br>If the query exceeds this amount of time, the process cancels this query automatically.|
|keep_on_completion|query|boolean|false|Whether to save the results in the cluster after the search is complete. You can examine the stored results at a later time.|
|wait_for_completion_timeout|query|string|false|The amount of time to wait for the results. You can poll the remaining results based on an ID. The maximum value is 300 seconds. Default is `1s`.|
|pretty|query|boolean|false|Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.|
|human|query|boolean|false|Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.|
|error_trace|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.|
|source|query|string|false|The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.|
|filter_path|query|[_common___StringOrStringArray](#schema_common___stringorstringarray)|false|A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.|
|body|body|[asynchronous_search._common___Search](#schemaasynchronous_search._common___search)|false|none|
